title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims
title_zh: 审计产品而非递归过程：递归自我改进声明背后的评估证据

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) promises AI systems, such as self-evolving LLM agents, that become better at producing further improvements. Evaluating this promise requires separating product claims about the final system from process claims about the improvement process itself. Existing surveys specify the evidence these claims require, but how often studies report that evidence remains unmeasured. We examine this question through full-text coding of 114 eligible studies in a reproducible arXiv search frame frozen in October 2026, including 90 that describe their own systems as RSI. The codebook links claims to evaluation designs. Independent human coding, third-reader adjudication, and a separate blind coding of improver comparisons assess coding reliability. Among the 90 RSI studies, 90% report product evaluation beyond development tasks under a broad criterion that includes partial or unstated separation, while 60% report evaluation on tasks unused for selection. Only 22% audit two or more reruns of the full loop. In a human-coded random sample, the RSI studies show the same contrast: 45% evaluate on tasks unused for selection and 14% audit two or more reruns. Of the 26 studies claiming a better improvement procedure, 23 report a related comparison, but only 4 compare earlier and later procedures from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. Across these results and a comparison set of established works, evidence for repeatability and improved procedures remains less developed than product evaluation. Three propositions explain how selection effects, shared evaluator errors, and changes in system state limit what product evaluations can establish. Together, the findings support a claim-indexed reporting standard that connects each claim to the evaluation design needed to test it.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）有望使自我进化的LLM智能体等AI系统越来越擅长产生进一步的改进。 评估这一前景需要将关于最终系统的成果主张与关于改进过程本身的过程主张区分开来。 已有综述明确了这些主张所需的证据，但研究在多大程度上报告了这些证据仍未被测量。 我们通过对可复现的arXiv检索框架（于2026年10月冻结）中114篇符合条件的研究进行全文编码来考察这一问题，其中90篇将自己的系统描述为RSI。 该编码手册将主张与评估设计联系起来。 通过独立的人工编码、第三方读者的裁决，以及对改进器对比的另一次盲编码来评估编码的可靠性。 在90篇RSI研究中，90%在宽松标准（包括部分或未明确说明的分离）下报告了超越开发任务的成果评估，而60%报告了在未用于选择任务上的评估。 只有22%审计了完整循环的两次或更多次重跑。 在人工编码的随机样本中，RSI研究显示出同样的对比：45%在未用于选择的任务上进行评估，14%审计两次或更多次重跑。 在26篇声称拥有更好改进程序的研究中，23篇报告了相关比较，但只有4篇在匹配预算下比较了来自相同起始产物的早期与后期程序。 在这些结果与一组成熟著作的比较集来看，可重复性和改进程序的证据仍不如成果评估那样成熟。 三个命题解释了选择效应、评估者共享错误以及系统状态变化如何限制成果评估所能确立的内容。 总体而言，这些发现支持一种按主张索引的报告标准，将每项主张与其所需的评估设计联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Language models increasingly participate in the processes that improve AI systems. They revise prompts and agent harnesses, which coordinate a model’s tools and actions [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . They also generate feedback for updating model weights [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] and modify data and training pipelines [ 8 , 9 ] . Some systems also modify the procedure that proposes changes, which we call the improver , or the evaluator that decides which changes to retain [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] . These developments motivate the ambition of recursive self-improvement (RSI): retained improvements should enable the system to produce further improvements, potentially by making the improver itself more effective.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型越来越多地参与到改进人工智能系统的过程中。 它们修订提示词和智能体框架，后者负责协调模型的工具与动作 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 它们还会为更新模型权重生成反馈 [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] ，并修改数据和训练流程 [ 8 , 9 ] 。 一些系统还会修改提出变更的程序（我们称之为改进器），或决定保留哪些变更的评估器 [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] 。 这些进展激发了递归自我改进（RSI）的雄心：被保留的改进应当使系统能够产生进一步的改进，这可能是通过让改进器本身更加有效来实现的。

sents.zh: 这些进展激发了递归自我改进（RSI）的雄心：被保留的改进应当使系统能够产生进一步的改进，这可能是通过让改进器本身更加有效来实现的。

paragraphs.en: This ambition creates an evaluation problem. A higher final benchmark score establishes something about the resulting system, but it does not by itself establish how the improvement process behaves. Whether gains accumulate across rounds, recur in independent runs, or result from a better improver are distinct empirical questions. We refer to these as process claims , in contrast to a product claim about the performance of the final system. Evaluating RSI requires matching the evidence to the particular claim being made.
paragraphs.zh: 这一雄心带来一个评估问题。 更高的最终基准分数能证明关于所得系统的某些事情，但其本身并不能证明改进过程的表现如何。 收益是否会在各轮之间累积、是否会在独立运行中复现、或是否源于一个更好的改进者，这些都是不同的实证问题。 我们将这些称为过程主张，与关于最终系统性能的产品主张相对。 评估递归自我改进需要将证据与所提出的特定主张相匹配。

sents.en: Evaluating RSI requires matching the evidence to the particular claim being made.

paragraphs.en: The distinction matters because the signal used to select changes can disagree with the property the system is intended to improve. In one self-play study, a model’s own judge increasingly accepts its outputs while hidden exact-match accuracy remains unchanged [ 15 ] . In a robotics study, accepted skill changes repeatedly pass their tests, yet the target task never succeeds [ 16 ] . Both cases distinguish the development signal , which guides the loop’s choices, from an audit , which assesses the claimed improvement outside those choices. Even a successful audit of the final product leaves open whether the loop produces gains repeatably or whether its improver has become better.
paragraphs.zh: 这种区分之所以重要，是因为用于筛选变更的信号可能与系统本应改进的性质不一致。 在一项自我博弈研究中，模型自身的评判者越来越接受其输出，而隐藏的精确匹配准确率却保持不变 [ 15 ]。 在一项机器人研究中，被接受的技能变更反复通过其测试，但目标任务却从未成功 [ 16 ]。 这两个案例都区分了引导循环选择的开发信号与在这些选择之外评估所声称改进的审计。 即使对最终产品成功进行了审计，也无法说明该循环是否能可重复地产生收益，或者其改进器是否变得更好。

paragraphs.en: Recent surveys provide principles for answering these questions. Wu et al. [17] distinguish task gains, retention and transfer, and improver gains. Their evaluation protocol includes protected test tasks, repeated runs, resource-matched controls, and comparisons of earlier and later improvers from common starting states. Wang et al. [18] require audit evidence appropriate to the component being changed, while Chen et al. [19] organize feedback sources by their verification strength. These accounts establish what evidence to seek. However, they do not measure how often studies report it. The remaining question is therefore empirical: how closely does the reported evaluation of RSI systems match the claims made about their improvement processes?
paragraphs.zh: 近期的综述为回答这些问题提供了原则。Wu 等人 [17] 区分了任务增益、保持与迁移，以及改进器增益。 他们的评估协议包括受保护的测试任务、多次重复运行、资源匹配的对照组，以及从相同起始状态对早期与后期改进器的比较。Wang 等人 [18] 要求与被更改组件相适应的审计证据，而 Chen 等人 [19] 则按验证强度对反馈来源进行了分类。 这些论述确立了应当寻求何种证据。 然而，它们并未衡量研究在多大频率上报告了这些证据。 因此，剩下的问题是经验性的：对递归自我改进（RSI）智能体系统的报告评估，与其对其改进过程所做主张的匹配程度如何？

paragraphs.en: We address this question through a census of eligible studies in a reproducible arXiv search frame. We code each study from its full text, using a codebook that translates existing evaluation principles into observable features of reported experiments. The dataset covers 114 eligible studies, of which 90 describe their own loops or systems as RSI, and records each study’s claims, development signal, evaluation boundary, grader, and process controls, with source locators identifying the supporting passages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在一个可复现的 arXiv 检索框架中对符合条件的研究进行普查来回答这一问题。 我们根据每项研究的全文进行编码，使用的编码手册将现有的评估原则转化为已报告实验的可观察特征。 该数据集涵盖 114 项符合条件的研究，其中 90 项将其自身的循环或系统描述为 RSI，并记录每项研究的声明、开发信号、评估边界、评分器与过程控制，同时以来源定位符标示支持性段落。

sents.zh: 我们通过在一个可复现的 arXiv 检索框架中对符合条件的研究进行普查来回答这一问题。

paragraphs.en: We ask three research questions. RQ1 asks, for each claim that RSI studies make, how often they report an evaluation design that bears on it. RQ2 asks whether the studies that claim a better improver report comparisons that can isolate an improver gain. RQ3 asks whether the findings hold under independent human coding and in established self-improvement research outside the search frame. We assess robustness through a random sample coded independently by a human and adjudicated by a third reader, separate blind coding of the improver comparisons, and a comparison set of 20 representative works selected by Wu et al. [17] , which we call anchor works.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出三个研究问题。 RQ1 询问，对于 RSI 研究所提出的每一项主张，这些研究在多大频率上报告了与之相关的评估设计。 RQ2 询问，那些声称拥有更好的改进器的研究，是否报告了能够分离出改进器增益的比较。 RQ3 询问，这些发现在独立的人工编码下，以及在搜索框架之外的既有自我改进研究中是否成立。 我们通过以下方式评估稳健性：由一名人工独立编码并由第三位读者裁决的随机样本、对改进器比较的独立盲编码，以及与 Wu 等人选取的 20 篇代表性工作所组成的对比集合。 即我们称之为锚定工作的文献 [17]。

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, the broad product-evaluation indicator covers 90% of the 90 studies. This indicator includes partial or unstated separation from development. However, only 60% report evaluation on tasks unused for any selection. Most studies that claim accumulating gains audit across rounds, whereas repeated evaluation of the loop itself is uncommon: 22% audit two or more reruns.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ1，宽泛的产品评估指标覆盖了 90 项研究中的 90%。该指标包含部分或未明说的与开发阶段的分离。然而，仅有 60% 报告了在未用于任何选择的任务上的评估。大多数声称收益逐步积累的研究会跨轮次进行审计，而对循环本身进行重复评估并不常见：仅 22% 审计了两次或更多次的重跑。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2, 23 of the 26 studies claiming a better improver report a related comparison. These comparisons usually favor the proposed process. However, only 4 compare an earlier and a later improver from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. This design isolates the improver’s contribution from changes in the system on which it acts. For RQ3, the human-coded sample confirms that audited reruns are rarer than selection-independent product evaluation within the same studies (14% against 45% for its RSI studies), and the anchor works show the same pattern. Studies’ own experiments further document cases in which development gains transfer only partly, or not at all, to external evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于RQ2，声称是更优改进器的26项研究中有23项报告了相关比较。 这些比较通常有利于所提出的流程。 然而，只有4项研究在匹配的预算下，从相同的起始工件出发，对一个较早的改进器和一个较晚的改进器进行比较。 这种设计将改进器自身的贡献与其所作用系统的变化隔离开来。 对于RQ3，人工编码样本证实，在同一批研究中，经审计的重跑比与选择无关的产品评估更为罕见（其RSI研究中分别为14%和45%），而锚定研究也显示出相同的模式。 这些研究自身的实验进一步记录了这样一种情况：开发阶段的收益只能部分迁移到外部评估，甚至完全无法迁移。

paragraphs.en: The study contributes both measurement and guidance for evaluation. First, the dataset records claims and evidence for every eligible study in the frozen search frame, including the adjudicated sample and independently coded improver comparisons. Second, the accompanying codebook makes the evaluation requirements measurable and provides evidence on coding reliability. These two resources answer RQ1–RQ3. Third, three propositions explain the limits of inferring process gains from product evidence. Finally, a reporting standard links each claim to the required evaluation, using the observed rates as a baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究为评估提供了测量方法和指导。首先，该数据集记录了冻结检索范围内每项符合条件研究的声明与证据，包括经裁决的样本以及独立编码的改进者比较。其次，随附的编码手册使评估要求可测量，并提供了编码可靠性的证据。这两项资源回答了 RQ1–RQ3。第三，三个命题解释了从成果证据推断过程增益的局限性。最后，一份报告标准将每项声明与所需的评估联系起来，并以观察到的比率作为基线。

paragraphs.en: Our study draws on three lines of research: surveys that organize self-improving systems, research on evaluation reliability, and empirical meta-research that measures evaluation practice across published papers. The surveys identify which components can change and what those changes are intended to achieve. Evaluation research explains why an apparent gain may depend on the feedback source, the grader, or the use of test data. Meta-research supplies the method: coding published papers to measure how claims are evaluated. We apply that method to the claims of RSI research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究借鉴了三条研究脉络：对自我改进系统进行梳理的综述、关于评估可靠性的研究，以及测量已发表论文中评估实践的实证元研究。 这些综述识别出哪些组件可以改变，以及这些改变旨在实现什么目标。 评估研究解释了为什么表面的提升可能取决于反馈来源、评分者或测试数据的使用。 元研究提供了方法：对已发表论文进行编码，以测量相关论断是如何被评估的。 我们将该方法应用于递归自我改进（RSI）研究中的论断。

paragraphs.en: Surveys of self-evolving agents organize methods by the object, timing, mechanism, and setting of an update [ 20 , 21 ] . Related accounts describe the cycle from experience acquisition to evaluation [ 22 ] , distinguish foundation-model and scaffold updates [ 23 ] , and connect RSI design choices to classical learning mechanisms [ 24 ] . Feedback taxonomies distinguish internal, external, multi-agent, and human signals [ 25 ] , while safety surveys examine how risks persist through retained state [ 26 , 27 ] . Roadmaps and formal frameworks further characterize the requirements and limits of RSI [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 关于自进化智能体的综述按更新的对象、时机、机制和场景对方法进行组织 [ 20 , 21 ] 。 相关论述描述了从经验获取到评估的循环 [ 22 ] ，区分了基础模型更新与脚手架更新 [ 23 ] ，并将 RSI 的设计选择与经典学习机制相联系 [ 24 ] 。 反馈分类法区分了内部、外部、多智能体和人类信号 [ 25 ] ，而安全性综述则考察了风险如何通过保留的状态持续存在 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 路线图与形式化框架进一步刻画了 RSI 的要求与局限 [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Three surveys provide the closest basis for our coding framework. Wu et al. [17] distinguish task gains, retention and transfer, and improver gains. They propose a paired probe that applies earlier and later improvers to the same starting states under the same budget, alongside sealed test tasks, scheduled checkpoints, repeated runs, and fixed-improver controls. Their protocol descriptions cover eight selected works. Wang et al. [18] organize self-evolution into five levels, from outputs to evaluation criteria, and match each level to external audits and controls. Chen et al. [19] map 1,250 arXiv records by the component being improved and the extent of autonomous loop closure, using title and abstract keyword rules. Their verification hierarchy characterizes feedback quality qualitatively.
paragraphs.zh: 三项综述为我们的编码框架提供了最接近的基础。Wu 等人 [17] 区分了任务收益、保留与迁移，以及改进器收益。 他们提出了一种配对探针方法，在相同预算下将早期和后期改进器应用于相同的起始状态，并同时使用封闭测试任务、定期检查点、重复运行和固定改进器对照。 他们的协议描述涵盖了八项选定的工作。Wang 等人 [18] 将自我进化组织为五个层级，从输出到评估标准，并将每个层级与外部审计和对照相匹配。Chen 等人 [19] 通过被改进的组件和自主闭环的程度，使用标题和摘要关键词规则对 1,250 条 arXiv 记录进行映射。 他们的验证层级以定性方式刻画了反馈质量。

paragraphs.en: Two further surveys offer complementary qualitative assessments. Ye et al. [31] separate task-level refinement, lasting self-improvement and RSI, which also requires a better capacity to make further improvements, and call for independent evaluation and full cost reporting. Wu et al. [32] synthesize evidence on AI improving AI and conclude that evidence for persistent and compounding improvement remains limited. Table 1 places our study alongside these accounts: we operationalize their requirements through full-text coding on a defined search frame, with a separate comparison set and checks of coding agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 另有两项综述提供了互补的定性评估。Ye 等人 [31] 区分了任务级细化、持续自我改进以及 RSI（后者还需要更强的进一步改进能力），并呼吁开展独立评估和完整的成本报告。Wu 等人 [32] 综合了关于 AI 改进 AI 的证据，并得出结论：关于持续且不断叠加的改进，证据仍然有限。 表 1 将我们的研究与这些论述并列：我们通过在明确的检索框架内进行全文编码来落实他们的要求，并设有单独的对照集和编码一致性检查。

paragraphs.en: The need to distinguish development feedback from evaluation is already apparent in task-local self-correction. Self-feedback can improve an answer through iterative refinement [ 33 ] , but reasoning corrections often fail without external signals [ 34 ] . Tool-based critique can provide such signals [ 35 ] . Surveys synthesize these findings across correction strategies [ 36 , 37 ] . Persistent self-improvement extends the question beyond a single answer. Systems retain updates based on correctness-filtered rationales [ 38 ] , self-generated judgments [ 5 , 13 ] , human-anchored self-play [ 6 ] , or AI feedback [ 39 ] . Agents can also preserve reflections, skills, and experience across tasks [ 40 , 41 , 42 ] . Retention makes gains reusable, but it can also preserve errors: recursive data generation and self-play can narrow distributions or degrade performance [ 43 , 44 , 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在任务局部自我修正中，区分开发反馈与评估的需求已经十分明显。 自我反馈可以通过迭代改进来提升答案 [ 33 ]，但缺乏外部信号时，推理修正往往会失败 [ 34 ]。 基于工具的批评可以提供此类信号 [ 35 ]。 综述工作对各种修正策略下的这些发现进行了归纳 [ 36 , 37 ]。 持续自我改进将这一问题扩展到了单个答案之外。 系统会基于经正确性过滤的理据 [ 38 ]、自我生成的判断 [ 5 , 13 ]、以人类为锚点的自我博弈 [ 6 ] 或 AI 反馈 [ 39 ] 来保留更新。 智能体还可以跨任务保存反思、技能与经验 [ 40 , 41 , 42 ]。 保留使收益可复用，但也可能保留错误：递归的数据生成和自我博弈可能使分布收窄或导致性能退化 [ 43 , 44 , 45 ]。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator itself provides another source of error. LLM judges exhibit position, verbosity, and self-enhancement biases [ 46 , 47 ] . Reward models can be assessed against preference data [ 48 ] , yet continued optimization of their scores can reduce the underlying reward [ 49 ] . Formal work characterizes reward gaming [ 50 ] , and experiments show that behavior learned in gameable environments can extend to reward tampering [ 51 ] . Weak supervisors can nevertheless elicit stronger behavior under some conditions [ 52 ] . These results make the validity of the feedback source an empirical question, especially when an RSI loop can modify its own evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器本身提供了另一个误差来源。 大语言模型裁判表现出位置、冗长和自我增强偏差 [46, 47]。 奖励模型可以对照偏好数据进行评估 [48]，但对其分数的持续优化可能会降低底层奖励 [49]。 形式化研究刻画了奖励作弊现象 [50]，实验表明在可被作弊的环境中习得的行为可能延伸到奖励篡改 [51]。 尽管如此，弱监督者在某些条件下仍能引发更强的行为 [52]。 这些结果使反馈来源的有效性成为一个经验性问题，尤其是在 RSI 循环可以修改其自身评估器的情况下。

paragraphs.en: Even a fixed evaluator can become unreliable when its data are reused for selection. The reusable holdout [ 53 ] and the Ladder mechanism [ 54 ] address this adaptive reuse, although empirical studies of ImageNet and Kaggle report less overfitting than worst-case theory predicts [ 55 , 56 ] . Sun et al. [57] apply this reasoning to RSI through REUSE, a promotion framework with a specified error guarantee. In their live experiments, the share of false promotions falls from up to 20.7% under existing evaluation frameworks to zero. This line of work motivates the distinction between a development score used for selection and an audit used to assess the resulting claim.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是固定的评估器，当其数据被重复用于选择时，也可能变得不可靠。 可复用留出集 [ 53 ] 与 Ladder 机制 [ 54 ] 正是针对这种自适应复用提出的，尽管针对 ImageNet 和 Kaggle 的实证研究报告的过拟合程度低于最坏情况理论所预测的水平 [ 55 , 56 ] 。Sun 等人 在 [57] 中将这一推理通过 REUSE 应用于 RSI，REUSE 是一个具有明确误差保证的晋升框架。 在他们的在线实验中，虚假晋升的比例从现有评估框架下最高 20.7% 降至零。 这一系列工作促使人们区分用于选择的发展分数与用于评估所得结论的审计。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks make these evaluation questions concrete. They examine retained memory and skills [ 58 ] , data-centric research [ 59 ] , algorithm design [ 60 ] , and embodied improvement under matched source conditions [ 61 ] . Other environments support RSI experiments directly [ 62 , 63 ] , track skill evolution across rounds [ 64 ] , or compare evolving and non-evolving agents to attribute safety failures to earlier updates [ 65 ] . Together, these studies supply the evaluation principles and controls that our census measures.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的基准测试使这些评估问题变得具体。 它们考察了保留的记忆与技能 [ 58 ]、以数据为中心的研究 [ 59 ]、算法设计 [ 60 ]，以及在相同来源条件下的具身改进 [ 61 ]。 其他环境支持直接开展递归自我改进（RSI）实验 [ 62 , 63 ]、跨轮次追踪技能演化 [ 64 ]，或对比演化与非演化智能体，以便将安全故障归因于更早的更新 [ 65 ]。 这些研究共同提供了本普查所度量的评估原则与控制手段。

paragraphs.en: Methodologically, the study belongs to empirical meta-research on machine learning evaluation, which codes published papers or reruns published experiments to measure how results are established. Gundersen and Kjensmo [66] scored 400 AAAI and IJCAI papers on the variables needed to reproduce them and found that none documented all of them. Marie et al. [67] annotated the evaluations in 769 machine translation papers and found a growing reliance on differences in BLEU scores without significance testing or human evaluation. Henderson et al. [68] showed that variance across runs makes reported deep reinforcement learning results hard to interpret, and Agarwal et al. [69] showed that most results on these benchmarks are point estimates from few runs. Dodge et al. [70] found model comparisons whose conclusions would change with more or less computation, and Kapoor and Narayanan [71] documented leakage between training and evaluation data across many fields that adopted machine learning. These studies examine how researchers support claims about final models. RSI research adds claims about the improvement process, so we code the evidence for each claim separately. The next section specifies how the evaluation principles map to the claims made by RSI studies.
paragraphs.zh: 在方法论上，本研究属于针对机器学习评估的实证元研究，即对已发表论文进行编码或重现已发表的实验，以衡量结果是如何建立的。 Gundersen 和 Kjensmo [66] 根据复现 400 篇 AAAI 和 IJCAI 论文所需的变量对其进行评分，发现没有一篇论文完整记录了所有这些变量。Marie 等人 [67] 对 769 篇机器翻译论文中的评估进行了标注，发现越来越依赖 BLEU 分数的差异，而缺乏显著性检验或人工评估。Henderson 等人 [68] 表明，不同运行之间的方差使得已报告的深度强化学习结果难以解释，而 Agarwal 等人 [69] 表明，这些基准上的大多数结果都是来自少量运行的点估计。Dodge 等人 [70] 发现一些模型比较的结论会随着计算量的增减而改变，Kapoor 和 Narayanan [71] 则记录了在众多采用机器学习的领域中训练数据与评估数据之间的信息泄露。 这些研究考察的是研究者如何支持关于最终模型的结论。 RSI 研究还增加了关于改进过程的结论，因此我们分别对每项结论的证据进行编码。 下一节将具体说明这些评估原则如何对应 RSI 研究所提出的各项结论。

paragraphs.en: The codebook measures three aspects of an RSI study: the kinds of change a loop makes, the roles of development and audit evidence, and the claims that RSI studies make. We express the distinctions of Wu et al. [17] and Wang et al. [18] as items that can be coded from a paper, with separate attention to the repeatability of the loop and the independence of the audit grader.
paragraphs.zh: 该编码表衡量 RSI 研究的三个方面：循环所带来的变化类型、开发与审计证据的作用，以及 RSI 研究所提出的论断。 我们将 Wu 等人 [17] 和 Wang 等人的区分 [18] 表达为可以从论文中编码的条目，并分别关注循环的可重复性和审计评分者的独立性。

sents.en: The codebook measures three aspects of an RSI study: the kinds of change a loop makes, the roles of development and audit evidence, and the claims that RSI studies make.
sents.zh: 该编码表衡量 RSI 研究的三个方面：循环所带来的变化类型、开发与审计证据的作用，以及 RSI 研究所提出的论断。

sents.en: We express the distinctions of Wu et al. [17] and Wang et al.
sents.zh: 我们将 Wu 等人 [17] 和 Wang 等人的区分

sents.en: [18] as items that can be coded from a paper, with separate attention to the repeatability of the loop and the independence of the audit grader.
sents.zh: [18] 表达为可以从论文中编码的条目，并分别关注循环的可重复性和审计评分者的独立性。

paragraphs.en: The first distinction concerns what changes. Following prior work [ 36 , 18 ] , we separate four kinds of change. A task-local correction changes the answer or trajectory for the current task only. A persistent change alters retained state, such as weights, prompts, memory, tools, skills or harness code, and that state affects later tasks. A structural change alters the improver. A criterion change alters the evaluator or the definition of success. A study can make several of these changes at once. Retaining state does not establish that the state improves later performance. Similarly, an editable improver is not necessarily a more effective one.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个区别涉及什么发生了变化。 沿用先前的工作 [36, 18]，我们区分出四类变化。 任务局部修正只改变当前任务的答案或轨迹。 持久性变化会改变被保留的状态，例如权重、提示、记忆、工具、技能或框架代码，并且该状态会影响后续任务。 结构性变化会改变改进者本身。 标准变化会改变评估者或成功的定义。 一项研究可以同时做出其中多种变化。 保留状态并不足以证明该状态能提升后续表现。 同样，可编辑的改进者并不一定是更有效的改进者。

sents.en: The first distinction concerns what changes.
sents.zh: 第一个区别涉及什么发生了变化。

sents.en: Following prior work [ 36 , 18 ] , we separate four kinds of change.
sents.zh: 沿用先前的工作 [36, 18]，我们区分出四类变化。

sents.en: A task-local correction changes the answer or trajectory for the current task only.
sents.zh: 任务局部修正只改变当前任务的答案或轨迹。

sents.en: A persistent change alters retained state, such as weights, prompts, memory, tools, skills or harness code, and that state affects later tasks.
sents.zh: 持久性变化会改变被保留的状态，例如权重、提示、记忆、工具、技能或框架代码，并且该状态会影响后续任务。

sents.en: A structural change alters the improver.
sents.zh: 结构性变化会改变改进者本身。

sents.en: A criterion change alters the evaluator or the definition of success.
sents.zh: 标准变化会改变评估者或成功的定义。

sents.en: A study can make several of these changes at once.
sents.zh: 一项研究可以同时做出其中多种变化。

sents.en: Retaining state does not establish that the state improves later performance.
sents.zh: 保留状态并不足以证明该状态能提升后续表现。

sents.en: Similarly, an editable improver is not necessarily a more effective one.
sents.zh: 同样，可编辑的改进者并不一定是更有效的改进者。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating these changes requires separating two roles for feedback. The development signal guides proposals, rankings, or acceptance decisions within the loop. The signal can be a unit test, an environment outcome, a reference answer, the system’s own judgment, or a learned scorer such as a reward model or an LLM judge. We use the term model judge for such learned scorers.
paragraphs.zh: 评估这些变化需要区分两种反馈角色。 开发信号用于在循环内引导提议、排序或接受决策。 该信号可以是单元测试、环境结果、参考答案、系统自身的判断，或者是学习得到的评分器，例如奖励模型或 LLM 评审者。 我们将这类学习得到的评分器称为模型评审者（model judge）。

sents.en: Evaluating these changes requires separating two roles for feedback.
sents.zh: 评估这些变化需要区分两种反馈角色。

sents.en: The development signal guides proposals, rankings, or acceptance decisions within the loop.
sents.zh: 开发信号用于在循环内引导提议、排序或接受决策。

sents.en: The signal can be a unit test, an environment outcome, a reference answer, the system’s own judgment, or a learned scorer such as a reward model or an LLM judge.
sents.zh: 该信号可以是单元测试、环境结果、参考答案、系统自身的判断，或者是学习得到的评分器，例如奖励模型或 LLM 评审者。

sents.en: We use the term model judge for such learned scorers.
sents.zh: 我们将这类学习得到的评分器称为模型评审者（model judge）。

paragraphs.en: An audit evaluates the claimed improvement independently of the choices made during development. This independence has two components. The first concerns the tasks. The matched-audit principle of Wang et al. [18] and the sealed test tasks of Wu et al. [17] require that audit tasks were never used to select changes, checkpoints or hyperparameters. We call such tasks held out. The second concerns the grader: the audit grader must not share the development judge’s systematic errors. A held-out benchmark scored by the same judge family that guided the search has the first kind of independence and may lack the second.
paragraphs.zh: 审计独立于开发过程中所做的选择来评估所声称的改进。 这种独立性包含两个组成部分。 第一个涉及任务。 Wang 等人的匹配审计原则。 [18] 以及 Wu 等人的密封测试任务。 [17] 要求审计任务从未被用于选择改动、检查点或超参数。 我们将这类任务称为留置任务。 第二个涉及评分者：审计评分者不得带有开发裁判所犯的系统性错误。 一个由指导搜索的同一裁判家族来评分的留置基准测试具备第一种独立性，但可能缺乏第二种。

sents.zh: 这种独立性包含两个组成部分。

sents.en: The first concerns the tasks.
sents.zh: 第一个涉及任务。

sents.en: The matched-audit principle of Wang et al.
sents.zh: Wang 等人的匹配审计原则。

sents.en: [18] and the sealed test tasks of Wu et al.
sents.zh: [18] 以及 Wu 等人的密封测试任务。

sents.zh: 我们将这类任务称为留置任务。

sents.zh: 第二个涉及评分者：审计评分者不得带有开发裁判所犯的系统性错误。

sents.zh: 一个由指导搜索的同一裁判家族来评分的留置基准测试具备第一种独立性，但可能缺乏第二种。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 lists the claims that RSI papers make, from product performance to improvement of the process, with the evidence each needs and the census items that record it. The product claim (C1) says that the final system is better than the initial system under a fixed evaluation budget. It corresponds to the task gain of Wu et al. [17] . The other four claims concern the process. The claims are distinct rather than nested. Repeatable final gains need not rise at every round, and a later improver can outperform an earlier one at a common state even when the historical trajectory does not accumulate gains. A study therefore needs the evidence for each claim it makes, and a study that claims only a better product needs only the evidence for C1.
paragraphs.zh: 表2列出了RSI论文所提出的主张，从产品性能到流程改进，以及每种主张所需的证据和记录该证据的普查条目。 产品主张（C1）指的是在固定评估预算下，最终系统优于初始系统。 它对应于Wu等人[17]的任务增益。 其余四项主张涉及流程。 这些主张是相互区别的，而非嵌套关系。 可复现的最终增益不必在每一轮都上升，即使历史轨迹没有累积增益，后来的改进者在同一状态下也可能胜过较早的改进者。 因此，一项研究需要为其提出的每项主张提供证据，而只主张产品更好的研究仅需提供C1的证据。

sents.en: Table 2 lists the claims that RSI papers make, from product performance to improvement of the process, with the evidence each needs and the census items that record it.
sents.zh: 表2列出了RSI论文所提出的主张，从产品性能到流程改进，以及每种主张所需的证据和记录该证据的普查条目。

sents.en: The product claim (C1) says that the final system is better than the initial system under a fixed evaluation budget.
sents.zh: 产品主张（C1）指的是在固定评估预算下，最终系统优于初始系统。

sents.en: It corresponds to the task gain of Wu et al. [17] .
sents.zh: 它对应于Wu等人[17]的任务增益。

sents.en: The other four claims concern the process.
sents.zh: 其余四项主张涉及流程。

sents.en: The claims are distinct rather than nested.
sents.zh: 这些主张是相互区别的，而非嵌套关系。

sents.en: Repeatable final gains need not rise at every round, and a later improver can outperform an earlier one at a common state even when the historical trajectory does not accumulate gains.
sents.zh: 可复现的最终增益不必在每一轮都上升，即使历史轨迹没有累积增益，后来的改进者在同一状态下也可能胜过较早的改进者。

sents.en: A study therefore needs the evidence for each claim it makes, and a study that claims only a better product needs only the evidence for C1.
sents.zh: 因此，一项研究需要为其提出的每项主张提供证据，而只主张产品更好的研究仅需提供C1的证据。

paragraphs.en: Accumulation (C2) says that audited performance rises across retained rounds, which scheduled audits of intermediate checkpoints can show. Repeatability (C3) says that the loop, rerun from the same start, produces gains, so the result is not one lucky trajectory. Accumulation in one run and repeatability across runs therefore require different observations.
paragraphs.zh: 累积性（C2）指被审计的性能在保留的轮次间持续上升，这一点可以通过对中间检查点的定期审计来展示。 可重复性（C3）指从同一起点重新运行该循环也能产生增益，因此结果并非一次侥幸的轨迹。 因此，单次运行内的累积性和多次运行间的可重复性需要不同的观测手段。

sents.en: Accumulation (C2) says that audited performance rises across retained rounds, which scheduled audits of intermediate checkpoints can show.
sents.zh: 累积性（C2）指被审计的性能在保留的轮次间持续上升，这一点可以通过对中间检查点的定期审计来展示。

sents.en: Repeatability (C3) says that the loop, rerun from the same start, produces gains, so the result is not one lucky trajectory.
sents.zh: 可重复性（C3）指从同一起点重新运行该循环也能产生增益，因此结果并非一次侥幸的轨迹。

sents.en: Accumulation in one run and repeatability across runs therefore require different observations.
sents.zh: 因此，单次运行内的累积性和多次运行间的可重复性需要不同的观测手段。

paragraphs.en: Improver gain (C4) says that a later improver produces better successors than an earlier one from the same start and with the same budget. A swap test checks this claim by applying the earlier and later improvers to the same starting system and auditing the successors they produce. By contrast, the frozen-improver control of Zhang et al. [1] compares a run in which the improver can change with one in which it remains fixed. This evolving-versus-frozen comparison tests whether allowing the improver to change helps over a full run.
paragraphs.zh: 改进者增益（C4）指的是，在相同起点和相同预算下，较晚的智能体（改进者）能产生比较早的智能体更好的后继系统。 交换测试通过将较早和较晚的智能体应用于相同的起始系统，并审计它们产生的后继系统，来检验这一论断。 相比之下，Zhang 等人的冻结改进者对照实验 [1] 将允许改进者变化的运行与改进者保持固定的运行进行比较。 这种“演化对冻结”的比较检验的是，允许改进者发生变化是否能在整个运行过程中带来帮助。

sents.en: Improver gain (C4) says that a later improver produces better successors than an earlier one from the same start and with the same budget.
sents.zh: 改进者增益（C4）指的是，在相同起点和相同预算下，较晚的智能体（改进者）能产生比较早的智能体更好的后继系统。

sents.en: A swap test checks this claim by applying the earlier and later improvers to the same starting system and auditing the successors they produce.
sents.zh: 交换测试通过将较早和较晚的智能体应用于相同的起始系统，并审计它们产生的后继系统，来检验这一论断。

sents.en: By contrast, the frozen-improver control of Zhang et al.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Zhang 等人的冻结改进者对照实验

sents.en: [1] compares a run in which the improver can change with one in which it remains fixed.
sents.zh: [1] 将允许改进者变化的运行与改进者保持固定的运行进行比较。

sents.en: This evolving-versus-frozen comparison tests whether allowing the improver to change helps over a full run.
sents.zh: 这种“演化对冻结”的比较检验的是，允许改进者发生变化是否能在整个运行过程中带来帮助。

paragraphs.en: Compounding (C5) extends C4 by claiming that improver gains themselves grow over time. C4 captures the distinctively recursive claim that the improvement procedure itself becomes more effective. A loop with a fixed improver can make C1 through C3 true, and many useful systems are of this kind. Repeatability matters for any iterative loop, recursive or not.
paragraphs.zh: 复合性（C5）是对 C4 的扩展，其主张改进收益本身会随时间增长。 C4 捕捉了独特的递归主张，即改进过程本身会变得更加有效。 一个带有固定改进器的循环可以使 C1 到 C3 成立，许多有用的系统就属于这种类型。 可重复性对任何迭代循环都很重要，无论其是否递归。

sents.en: Compounding (C5) extends C4 by claiming that improver gains themselves grow over time.
sents.zh: 复合性（C5）是对 C4 的扩展，其主张改进收益本身会随时间增长。

sents.en: C4 captures the distinctively recursive claim that the improvement procedure itself becomes more effective.
sents.zh: C4 捕捉了独特的递归主张，即改进过程本身会变得更加有效。

sents.en: A loop with a fixed improver can make C1 through C3 true, and many useful systems are of this kind.
sents.zh: 一个带有固定改进器的循环可以使 C1 到 C3 成立，许多有用的系统就属于这种类型。

sents.en: Repeatability matters for any iterative loop, recursive or not.
sents.zh: 可重复性对任何迭代循环都很重要，无论其是否递归。

paragraphs.en: These claims also depend on the evaluation scope and comparator. The scope is the set of tasks, domains and evaluation conditions on which the claim is tested. A claim stated for open-ended domains but tested on executable benchmarks has a scope gap, even if every reported number is sound.
paragraphs.zh: 这些主张还取决于评估范围和对照对象。 范围是测试该主张时所依据的任务、领域和评估条件的集合。 一个针对开放式领域提出、却在可执行基准上进行测试的主张存在范围差距，即使所有报告的数字都是可靠的。

paragraphs.en: The comparator measures the gain obtainable with the same computational resources without recursion, for example from best-of- N N sampling, from a fixed improver run for the same number of proposals, or from a larger search with the initial system [ 17 ] . We call a baseline of this kind a budget-matched comparator. This comparison distinguishes gains attributable to the update mechanism from those obtainable by spending the same resources on additional search [ 12 , 8 ] . The following analysis explains why these distinctions matter: selection, grading, and the changing state of the system can each make product evidence insufficient for a process claim.
paragraphs.zh: 比较器衡量的是在不使用递归、使用相同计算资源的情况下可获得的增益，例如通过 best-of-N 采样、通过运行固定改进器生成相同数量的提案、或通过使用初始系统进行更大规模的搜索 [17]。 我们将这类基线称为预算匹配比较器。 这一比较能够区分归因于更新机制的增益，与将相同资源用于额外搜索即可获得的增益 [12, 8]。 以下分析解释了为什么这些区分很重要：选择、评级以及系统状态的变化，都可能使产品层面的证据不足以支撑关于过程的论断。

paragraphs.en: We analyze three evaluation problems behind the claim distinctions in Table 2 : selecting among noisy scores, sharing errors between development and audit graders, and changing the system and its improver together. For each problem, we state a proposition and connect it to the corresponding census items. The first is the winner’s curse: selecting the highest noisy score can overstate performance. Work on adaptive data analysis addresses this effect [ 53 , 54 ] , and Sun et al. [57] provide a formal treatment for RSI through a certified promotion rule. We illustrate this selection effect in terms of accepted changes and reported development gain. To our knowledge, the second and third have not been stated in this form for RSI. Proofs are in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析表 2 中所述区别背后的三个评估问题：在有噪声的分数中进行选择、开发评分器与审计评分器之间的误差共享，以及同时改变系统及其改进器。 针对每个问题，我们给出一个命题，并将其与相应的普查条目关联起来。 第一个是赢者诅咒：选择最高的有噪声分数可能会夸大性能。 关于自适应数据分析的工作研究了这种效应 [53, 54]，Sun 等人 [57] 通过认证的晋升规则对 RSI 提供了形式化处理。 我们以被接受的变更和所报告的开发增益为例说明这种选择效应。 据我们所知，第二个和第三个问题尚未针对 RSI 以这种形式被表述过。 证明见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Under this null model, development scores rise and changes are accepted even though true performance remains constant. The spurious gain grows with the number of candidates scored, not with the number of rounds. Three evaluation designs address this selection effect. An audit on tasks unused for selection, checkpoint choice, or hyperparameter tuning provides an external assessment (census item A2). A null control runs the same loop with shuffled feedback or proposals that cannot help, directly estimating the spurious gain (A5). A noise-aware promotion rule accounts for uncertainty when accepting a change (A6).
paragraphs.zh: 在该零模型下，即使真实性能保持不变，开发分数也会上升，且变更会被接受。 虚假增益随被评分的候选数量增长，而不是随轮次数增长。 三种评估设计用于解决这种选择效应。 在未用于选择、检查点选择或超参数调优的任务上进行审计，可提供一种外部评估（普查条目 A2）。 零对照通过打乱反馈或使用无法提供帮助的提案来运行相同的循环，直接估计虚假增益（A5）。 具备噪声感知的晋级规则在接受变更时会考虑不确定性（A6）。

paragraphs.en: These promotion rules offer different guarantees. Repeated evaluation reduces noise in each comparison, whereas a certified rule such as REUSE also controls the error that accumulates when the same data are reused adaptively across many comparisons [ 57 ] . The census item records both and does not distinguish them. The proposition also explains why reusing the final benchmark to choose a checkpoint weakens an otherwise held-out result, since each reuse is one more draw from which the maximum is taken.

paragraphs.en: The null-loop benchmark isolates the apparent gain that selection produces under independent development errors. It is a reference point rather than a bound for real loops, in which errors on shared development tasks are correlated, adaptively generated proposals need not have exchangeable errors, and acceptance margins change the number of records. Perfectly correlated errors, for example, produce no accepted changes at all. The conditional-mean assumption behind (iii) is what an audit with tasks and a grader that played no part in selection is meant to secure, but separation alone does not guarantee it.
paragraphs.zh: 零循环基准测试用于隔离在选择由独立开发错误产生的情况下所呈现的表观增益。 它是一个参照点，而非真实循环的上界；在真实循环中，共享开发任务上的错误是相关的，自适应生成的提案的错误未必可交换，而接受阈值会改变记录的数量。 例如，完全相关的错误根本不会产生任何被接受的更改。 (iii) 背后的条件均值假设，正是借助任务和未参与选择的评分器进行审计所要保障的内容，但仅仅分离本身并不能保证这一点。

paragraphs.en: The identity makes the conditions for an informative audit explicit. Held-out tasks make the residual condition plausible but do not guarantee it, and the sign of the distortion depends on λ \lambda and on how b b changes. Two consequences follow. sents.zh: 特别地，核 K ~ ( ⋅ ∣ s , I ) = K ( ⋅ ∣ s , ϕ ( s ) ) \tilde{K}(\cdot\mid s,I)=K(\cdot\mid s,\phi(s)) 在其之下改进器对结果没有影响，会生成相同的可观测变量分布。

sents.en: The improver contrast g ⁡ ( s , I ′ ) − g ⁡ ( s , ϕ ⁡ ( s ) ) g(s,I^{\prime})-g(s,\phi(s)) for I ′ ≠ ϕ ⁡ ( s ) I^{\prime}\neq\phi(s) is therefore not identified.
sents.zh: 因此，对于 I ′ ≠ ϕ ⁡ ( s ) I^{\prime}\neq\phi(s)，改进器对比 g ⁡ ( s , I ′ ) − g ⁡ ( s , ϕ ⁡ ( s ) ) g(s,I^{\prime})-g(s,\phi(s)) 不可识别。

paragraphs.en: The proposition describes a deterministic coupling with no overlap: at each solver state the run observes only one improver. Here, non-identification means that different explanations of the improver’s effect are compatible with exactly the same observed data. Co-evolution does not by itself imply this coupling, since different histories or random updates can produce different improvers at the same solver state, but loops that edit their improver only through their own retained changes come close to it. The identification problem arises because state and improver change together. Gains can shrink as the solver approaches its performance ceiling even while the improver gets better. They can also grow when a fixed improver reaches states that are easier to improve. The observed trajectory alone cannot distinguish these explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 该命题描述了一种无重叠的确定性耦合：在求解器的每个状态下，运行过程只观察到一个改进器。 在这里，不可识别性意味着关于改进器效果的不同解释与完全相同的观测数据相容。 协同演化本身并不蕴含这种耦合，因为不同的历史或随机更新可能在同一求解器状态下产生不同的改进器，但那些仅通过自身保留的变更来编辑其改进器的循环接近于这种耦合。 识别问题之所以产生，是因为状态与改进器共同变化。 即使改进器变得更好，当求解器接近其性能上限时，收益也可能缩小。 当固定的改进器到达更容易改进的状态时，收益也可能增长。 仅凭观测到的轨迹无法区分这些解释。

paragraphs.en: A two-state example shows why matching scores does not help. Let solver states A A and B B both score zero, and let any improver produce an expected gain of 0.1 from A A and 0.8 from B B . An earlier improver observed at A A and a later improver observed at B B differ by 0.7, although the improver contrast is zero at each state.
paragraphs.zh: 一个两状态（two-state）的例子说明了为什么匹配分数没有帮助。 设求解器状态 A A 和 B B 的得分均为零，并设任何改进器（improver）在 A A 处产生 0.1 的期望增益，在 B B 处产生 0.8 的期望增益。 在 A A 处被观测到的较早的改进器与在 B B 处被观测到的较晚的改进器相差 0.7，尽管在每个状态下改进器对比度均为零。

paragraphs.en: Under the unrestricted model, identification therefore requires observations off the diagonal: applying an improver to a state with which it was not originally observed. The most direct design runs an earlier and a later improver from identical starting artifacts, or from a declared distribution of starting states with paired or randomized assignment, under the same budget, and audits their successors. This is the swap test, which Wu et al. [17] call a paired probe and Srikanth et al. [12] an ignition test. It is related to clade-level metaproductivity, the performance of an agent’s descendants, which Wang et al. [72] use to guide search. Randomized assignment of improvers to solver states, or structural assumptions on K K , can also supply off-diagonal information. Additional trajectory data alone cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 在无约束模型下，识别因此需要非对角线上的观测：即把某个改进器应用于其最初未被观测到的状态。 最直接的设计是：在相同预算下，让一个较早的改进器和一个较晚的改进器从相同的起始工件出发，或从一个已声明的起始状态分布出发并采用配对或随机化分配，然后审计它们的后续产物。 这就是交换测试，Wu 等人 [17] 称之为配对探针，Srikanth 等人 [12] 称之为点火测试。 它与分支级元生产力相关，即某个智能体的后代的表现，Wang 等人 [72] 用它来指导搜索。 将改进器随机分配到求解器状态，或对 K K 施加结构性假设，也可以提供非对角线上的信息。 仅有额外的轨迹数据则无法做到这一点。

paragraphs.en: The target quantity, or estimand, should be stated: the difference in expected audited gain at one solver state, or its average over a declared set of starting states. Compounding claims extend the swap test over a stated horizon, since a few rounds of rising product scores do not establish growing improver gains.
paragraphs.zh: 应当明确说明目标量，即估计对象：在某一求解器状态下的期望审计增益之差，或其在所声明的起始状态集合上的平均值。 复合型主张需将交换检验延伸至一个明确的期限，因为仅凭少数几轮产品分数上升并不能证明改进者收益在持续增长。

paragraphs.en: An evolving-versus-frozen comparison at matched budget, in which one run’s improver is held fixed [ 1 ] , answers a different question. Its frozen arm generally visits different solver states, so its total effect measures the value of letting the improver change over a run. Without shared states or further assumptions, it need not provide the overlap required for the contrast between an earlier and a later improver at a common state. These distinctions determine which comparisons the census records. Section 5 describes how we translate them into coding decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在预算匹配的条件下进行演化与冻结的对比，其中一个运行的改进器被固定[1]，这回答的是另一个不同的问题。 其冻结分支通常访问不同的求解器状态，因此其总效应衡量的是让改进器在运行过程中发生变化的价值。 在没有共享状态或进一步假设的情况下，它未必能提供在共同状态下比较较早与较晚改进器所需的重叠。 这些区别决定了普查记录哪些比较。 第 5 节描述我们如何将它们转化为编码决策。

paragraphs.en: We answer the research questions with a quantitative content analysis of published studies. We first define the search frame and eligibility criteria, then describe the coded items, reliability checks, and analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过对已发表研究进行定量内容分析来回答研究问题。 我们首先定义检索框架和纳入标准，然后描述编码条目、信度检验和分析。

sents.en: We answer the research questions with a quantitative content analysis of published studies.
sents.zh: 我们通过对已发表研究进行定量内容分析来回答研究问题。

sents.en: We first define the search frame and eligibility criteria, then describe the coded items, reliability checks, and analysis.
sents.zh: 我们首先定义检索框架和纳入标准，然后描述编码条目、信度检验和分析。

paragraphs.en: The search frame consists of arXiv records whose title or abstract contains recursive self-improvement or a close variant, submitted up to 17 October 2026. We ran 12 title and abstract queries through the arXiv API and took their union, obtaining 173 records, including 85 with the phrase in the title. Of these records, 153 were posted in 2026 and 106 on or after 1 September 2026. Appendix C provides the queries and posting chronology. Searching by label defines a reproducible population for examining how RSI claims are evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 检索范围由 arXiv 记录构成，其标题或摘要包含“递归自我改进”或其近义变体，提交日期截至2026年10月17日。 我们通过 arXiv API 运行了12个标题和摘要查询并取其并集，得到173条记录，其中85条在标题中包含该短语。 在这些记录中，153条发布于2026年，106条发布于2026年9月1日或之后。 附录 C 提供了查询内容与发布时间线。 按标签检索定义了一个可复现的总体，用于考察 RSI 相关论断是如何被评估的。

sents.zh: 检索范围由 arXiv 记录构成，其标题或摘要包含“递归自我改进”或其近义变体，提交日期截至2026年10月17日。

sents.zh: 在这些记录中，153条发布于2026年，106条发布于2026年9月1日或之后。

sents.en: Appendix C provides the queries and posting chronology.
sents.zh: 附录 C 提供了查询内容与发布时间线。

sents.en: Searching by label defines a reproducible population for examining how RSI claims are evaluated.
sents.zh: 按标签检索定义了一个可复现的总体，用于考察 RSI 相关论断是如何被评估的。

paragraphs.en: A record is eligible if it presents an implemented loop in which an AI system’s outputs, evaluations, or experience are used to propose and retain changes, reports an experiment evaluating the result, and makes an improvement claim. We exclude surveys, position papers, purely theoretical analyses, and unrelated uses of the phrase. Benchmark, environment, and evaluation papers are eligible only if they also present and evaluate an improving system of their own. Records that invoke RSI solely as motivation for a method that does not improve itself are excluded, as are reports that specify a loop and an evaluation protocol but never run the loop. A study that runs its loop and describes the outcome qualitatively is eligible and enters the lowest evidence tier. Eligibility does not depend on the direction of the result, so studies whose loops fail remain in the census.
paragraphs.zh: 若一条记录展示了一个已实现的循环，其中 AI 系统的输出、评估或经验被用于提出并保留变更，报告了一项评估该结果的实验，并提出了改进声明，则该记录符合纳入条件。 我们排除综述、立场论文、纯理论分析以及该短语的无关用法。 基准、环境和评估类论文只有在它们同时展示并评估了自身的自我改进系统时才符合纳入条件。 仅将 RSI 作为动机、但方法本身并不改进自身的记录被排除在外；同样被排除的还有那些说明了循环和评估协议、却从未运行该循环的报告。 运行了其循环并对结果进行定性描述的研究符合纳入条件，并进入最低的证据等级。 纳入资格不取决于结果的方向，因此循环失败的研究仍保留在普查范围内。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 summarizes the screening process. Of the 114 eligible studies, 90 call their own loop or system RSI in the title, abstract, or introduction. We refer to these as strong-label studies . The remaining 24 use RSI as motivation, for example by describing their work as a step toward it, and are termed weak-label studies . The primary analysis concerns the strong-label studies. We also report results for all eligible studies and for the subset with the phrase in the title.

paragraphs.en: The unit of analysis is the study. We first record the claims made in its abstract, introduction, and conclusion: improved product performance, accumulation of gains, and improvement of the improver. We then code its evaluation using the items in Appendix B . Descriptive items identify what changes, whether the changed artifact belongs to the system running the loop, what persists between tasks, the number of rounds, the domain, the development signal, and any evaluator changes.
paragraphs.zh: 分析单位是研究本身。 我们首先记录其摘要、引言和结论中提出的主张：产品性能提升、增益的累积，以及改进者的改进。 然后，我们使用附录 B 中的条目对其评估进行编码。 描述性条目用于识别改变的内容、被改变的人工制品是否属于运行该循环的系统、任务之间持久保留的内容、轮数、领域、开发信号，以及任何评估器的变更。

sents.zh: 分析单位是研究本身。

sents.en: We first record the claims made in its abstract, introduction, and conclusion: improved product performance, accumulation of gains, and improvement of the improver.
sents.zh: 我们首先记录其摘要、引言和结论中提出的主张：产品性能提升、增益的累积，以及改进者的改进。

sents.en: We then code its evaluation using the items in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 然后，我们使用附录 B 中的条目对其评估进行编码。

sents.en: Descriptive items identify what changes, whether the changed artifact belongs to the system running the loop, what persists between tasks, the number of rounds, the domain, the development signal, and any evaluator changes.
sents.zh: 描述性条目用于识别改变的内容、被改变的人工制品是否属于运行该循环的系统、任务之间持久保留的内容、轮数、领域、开发信号，以及任何评估器的变更。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation items distinguish the source of the headline result (A1), the separation of product evaluation from development and selection (A2), and the audit grader (A3). A2 = Y records evaluation tasks unused for selection, including checkpoint and hyperparameter choice. We call this selection-independent evaluation . A2 = P covers three situations that we record separately: the evaluation tasks are also used for some selection, only part of the headline result is held out, or the paper does not state the separation. We report both the strict share (Y) and the combined share (Y or P). A3 records the type of audit grader. Additional items record a budget-matched comparator (A4), a null control with removed or randomized feedback (A5), and a noise-aware promotion rule (A6).
paragraphs.zh: 评估项用于区分标题结果的来源（A1）、产品评估与开发及选择的分离（A2），以及审计评分器（A3）。 A2 = Y 表示评估任务未用于选择，包括检查点选择和超参数选择。 我们将其称为与选择无关的评估。 A2 = P 涵盖三种我们分别记录的情况：评估任务也被用于某些选择、只有部分标题结果被保留出来，或者论文未说明这种分离。 我们同时报告严格占比（Y）和合并占比（Y 或 P）。 A3 记录审计评分器的类型。 其他评估项记录预算匹配的对照（A4）、移除或随机化反馈的空对照（A5），以及噪声感知的晋升规则（A6）。

sents.en: The evaluation items distinguish the source of the headline result (A1), the separation of product evaluation from development and selection (A2), and the audit grader (A3).
sents.zh: 评估项用于区分标题结果的来源（A1）、产品评估与开发及选择的分离（A2），以及审计评分器（A3）。

sents.en: A2 = Y records evaluation tasks unused for selection, including checkpoint and hyperparameter choice.
sents.zh: A2 = Y 表示评估任务未用于选择，包括检查点选择和超参数选择。

sents.en: We call this selection-independent evaluation .
sents.zh: 我们将其称为与选择无关的评估。

sents.en: A2 = P covers three situations that we record separately: the evaluation tasks are also used for some selection, only part of the headline result is held out, or the paper does not state the separation.
sents.zh: A2 = P 涵盖三种我们分别记录的情况：评估任务也被用于某些选择、只有部分标题结果被保留出来，或者论文未说明这种分离。

sents.en: We report both the strict share (Y) and the combined share (Y or P).
sents.zh: 我们同时报告严格占比（Y）和合并占比（Y 或 P）。

sents.en: A3 records the type of audit grader.
sents.zh: A3 记录审计评分器的类型。

sents.en: Additional items record a budget-matched comparator (A4), a null control with removed or randomized feedback (A5), and a noise-aware promotion rule (A6).
sents.zh: 其他评估项记录预算匹配的对照（A4）、移除或随机化反馈的空对照（A5），以及噪声感知的晋升规则（A6）。

paragraphs.en: Process items record audits across rounds or checkpoints (P1), paired development and audit scores for those rounds (P2), independent reruns of the full loop (P3), and whether at least two reruns have audit-level outcomes (P3a).
paragraphs.zh: 过程项记录跨轮次或检查点（P1）的审计、这些轮次的成对开发与审计评分（P2）、完整循环的独立重跑（P3），以及是否至少有两次重跑具有审计级结果（P3a）。

paragraphs.en: Item P4 records whether a study reports an improver-related comparison at a matched budget (Y), a partial or unmatched one (P), or none. We distinguish three designs because they answer different questions. A same-start comparison applies an earlier and a later improver to identical starting artifacts: it is the swap test discussed in Proposition 3 . An evolving-versus-frozen comparison tests the value of allowing the improver to change by comparing a full loop run with one in which the improver is fixed. Other comparisons include freezing an adaptive evaluator or curriculum, or swapping between different models.
paragraphs.zh: 条目 P4 记录一项研究是否报告了预算匹配条件下的改进器相关比较（Y）、部分匹配或不匹配的比较（P），或没有报告。 我们区分这三种设计，因为它们回答的是不同的问题。 同起点比较是将较早与较晚的改进器应用于相同的起始产物：这就是命题 3 中讨论的交换测试。 演进式与冻结式比较通过对比完整的循环运行与改进器被固定的运行，来检验允许改进器发生变化的价值。 其他比较包括冻结自适应评估器或课程，或在不同模型之间进行交换。

sents.en: Item P4 records whether a study reports an improver-related comparison at a matched budget (Y), a partial or unmatched one (P), or none.
sents.zh: 条目 P4 记录一项研究是否报告了预算匹配条件下的改进器相关比较（Y）、部分匹配或不匹配的比较（P），或没有报告。

sents.en: We distinguish three designs because they answer different questions.
sents.zh: 我们区分这三种设计，因为它们回答的是不同的问题。

sents.en: A same-start comparison applies an earlier and a later improver to identical starting artifacts: it is the swap test discussed in Proposition 3 .
sents.zh: 同起点比较是将较早与较晚的改进器应用于相同的起始产物：这就是命题 3 中讨论的交换测试。

sents.en: An evolving-versus-frozen comparison tests the value of allowing the improver to change by comparing a full loop run with one in which the improver is fixed.
sents.zh: 演进式与冻结式比较通过对比完整的循环运行与改进器被固定的运行，来检验允许改进器发生变化的价值。

sents.en: Other comparisons include freezing an adaptive evaluator or curriculum, or swapping between different models.
sents.zh: 其他比较包括冻结自适应评估器或课程，或在不同模型之间进行交换。

paragraphs.en: Finally, P5 records reported divergence between development and audit outcomes. It is coded NA (not applicable) when no audit is paired with development scores, because divergence cannot then be assessed. S1 records whether the scope that a study presents in its title, abstract and introduction, including statements of motivation, exceeds the setting it evaluates.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，P5 记录开发结果与审计结果之间所报告的差异。 当没有审计与开发评分相配对时，该项编码为 NA（不适用），因为此时无法评估差异。 S1 记录一项研究在其标题、摘要和引言（包括动机陈述）中所呈现的范围是否超出了它所评估的场景。

sents.en: Finally, P5 records reported divergence between development and audit outcomes.
sents.zh: 最后，P5 记录开发结果与审计结果之间所报告的差异。

sents.en: It is coded NA (not applicable) when no audit is paired with development scores, because divergence cannot then be assessed.
sents.zh: 当没有审计与开发评分相配对时，该项编码为 NA（不适用），因为此时无法评估差异。

sents.en: S1 records whether the scope that a study presents in its title, abstract and introduction, including statements of motivation, exceeds the setting it evaluates.
sents.zh: S1 记录一项研究在其标题、摘要和引言（包括动机陈述）中所呈现的范围是否超出了它所评估的场景。

paragraphs.en: Source locators connect the coding to the relevant sections, tables, figures, or appendices. The codes record which designs each study reports, whatever their results. A control that a study does not report counts as absent, not as failed. Four logical rules link the items. For example, a study without an audit cannot report a per-round audit or a development–audit divergence (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 来源定位符将编码与相关章节、表格、插图或附录连接起来。 编码记录每项研究报告了哪些设计，无论其结果如何。 某研究未报告的对照项记为缺失，而非失败。 四条逻辑规则将各条目关联起来。 例如，没有审核的研究不能报告每轮审核或开发—审核分歧（附录 B）。

sents.en: Source locators connect the coding to the relevant sections, tables, figures, or appendices.
sents.zh: 来源定位符将编码与相关章节、表格、插图或附录连接起来。

sents.en: The codes record which designs each study reports, whatever their results.
sents.zh: 编码记录每项研究报告了哪些设计，无论其结果如何。

sents.en: A control that a study does not report counts as absent, not as failed.
sents.zh: 某研究未报告的对照项记为缺失，而非失败。

sents.en: Four logical rules link the items.
sents.zh: 四条逻辑规则将各条目关联起来。

sents.en: For example, a study without an audit cannot report a per-round audit or a development–audit divergence (Appendix B ).
sents.zh: 例如，没有审核的研究不能报告每轮审核或开发—审核分歧（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Evidence tiers summarize which combinations of these designs a study reports. E0 denotes a demonstration without quantitative evaluation of the change, and E1 denotes a gain without evaluation beyond the development tasks. E2 requires fully or partly held-out product evaluation (A2 = Y or P). E3 additionally requires a per-round audit or audited reruns, and E4 adds an improver-related comparison at a matched budget (P4 = Y). Task-local studies are capped at E2. Because P4 pools the three improver designs, E4 serves as a summary, and the primary analysis relies on claim-specific indicators that separate the designs relevant to each claim.
paragraphs.zh: 证据层级概括了一项研究报告了这些设计的哪些组合。 E0 表示对变更没有定量评估的演示，E1 表示仅在开发任务之外没有评估的收益。 E2 要求完全或部分保留的产品评估（A2 = Y 或 P）。 E3 另外要求逐轮审计或经审计的重跑，E4 还要求在匹配预算下的改进器相关比较（P4 = Y）。 任务局部研究的上限为 E2。 由于 P4 汇集了三种改进器设计，E4 仅作为概要，主要分析依赖于区分与各论断相关设计的论断特定指标。

sents.en: Evidence tiers summarize which combinations of these designs a study reports.
sents.zh: 证据层级概括了一项研究报告了这些设计的哪些组合。

sents.en: E0 denotes a demonstration without quantitative evaluation of the change, and E1 denotes a gain without evaluation beyond the development tasks.
sents.zh: E0 表示对变更没有定量评估的演示，E1 表示仅在开发任务之外没有评估的收益。

sents.en: E2 requires fully or partly held-out product evaluation (A2 = Y or P).
sents.zh: E2 要求完全或部分保留的产品评估（A2 = Y 或 P）。

sents.en: E3 additionally requires a per-round audit or audited reruns, and E4 adds an improver-related comparison at a matched budget (P4 = Y).
sents.zh: E3 另外要求逐轮审计或经审计的重跑，E4 还要求在匹配预算下的改进器相关比较（P4 = Y）。

sents.en: Task-local studies are capped at E2.
sents.zh: 任务局部研究的上限为 E2。

sents.en: Because P4 pools the three improver designs, E4 serves as a summary, and the primary analysis relies on claim-specific indicators that separate the designs relevant to each claim.
sents.zh: 由于 P4 汇集了三种改进器设计，E4 仅作为概要，主要分析依赖于区分与各论断相关设计的论断特定指标。

paragraphs.en: We apply the same codebook to 20 anchor works , the representative studies selected by Wu et al. [17] in their Figure 8a. This set ranges from STaR [ 38 ] and Self-Instruct [ 73 ] to the Darwin Gödel Machine [ 1 ] and Hyperagents [ 11 ] . Only 2 belong to our search frame, so the other 18 provide a comparison with work outside the phrase-based search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将同一编码本应用于20项代表性研究，即Wu等人[17]在其图8a中选出的代表作。 这组研究涵盖从STaR[38]和Self-Instruct[73]到达尔文·哥德尔机[1]和Hyperagents[11]。 其中仅有2项属于我们的搜索框架，因此其余18项提供了与基于短语的搜索之外工作的对比。

sents.en: We apply the same codebook to 20 anchor works , the representative studies selected by Wu et al. [17] in their Figure 8a.
sents.zh: 我们将同一编码本应用于20项代表性研究，即Wu等人[17]在其图8a中选出的代表作。

sents.en: This set ranges from STaR [ 38 ] and Self-Instruct [ 73 ] to the Darwin Gödel Machine [ 1 ] and Hyperagents [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 这组研究涵盖从STaR[38]和Self-Instruct[73]到达尔文·哥德尔机[1]和Hyperagents[11]。

sents.en: Only 2 belong to our search frame, so the other 18 provide a comparison with work outside the phrase-based search.
sents.zh: 其中仅有2项属于我们的搜索框架，因此其余18项提供了与基于短语的搜索之外工作的对比。

paragraphs.en: Wu et al. also describe the evaluation protocols of eight anchor works in their Table 7. We map those descriptions to three coding dimensions, test separation, improver tests, and budget parity, and compare them with our full-text codes. An improver test in their sense is a paired probe or a frozen-improver control, so we compare it with our same-start and evolving-versus-frozen designs and count other improver-related comparisons as partial.
paragraphs.zh: Wu 等人还在其表 7 中描述了八篇奠基性工作的评估协议。 我们将这些描述映射到三个编码维度——测试分离、改进者测试与预算对等，并与我们的全文编码进行比较。 他们所称的改进者测试是指成对探针或冻结改进者对照，因此我们将其与我们的同起点设计与演化对冻结设计进行比较，并将其他与改进者相关的比较计为部分符合。

sents.en: Wu et al. also describe the evaluation protocols of eight anchor works in their Table 7.
sents.zh: Wu 等人还在其表 7 中描述了八篇奠基性工作的评估协议。

sents.en: We map those descriptions to three coding dimensions, test separation, improver tests, and budget parity, and compare them with our full-text codes.
sents.zh: 我们将这些描述映射到三个编码维度——测试分离、改进者测试与预算对等，并与我们的全文编码进行比较。

sents.en: An improver test in their sense is a paired probe or a frozen-improver control, so we compare it with our same-start and evolving-versus-frozen designs and count other improver-related comparisons as partial.
sents.zh: 他们所称的改进者测试是指成对探针或冻结改进者对照，因此我们将其与我们的同起点设计与演化对冻结设计进行比较，并将其他与改进者相关的比较计为部分符合。

paragraphs.en: The resulting dataset contains 30 coded items for each of the 114 eligible studies, 3,420 codes in all, and the same evidence items for the 20 anchor works. Each study carries locators to the sections, tables and figures that support its codes. The dataset also records the screening decision for each of the 173 records in the frame, the adjudication of the double-coded sample and the independent codes of the improver comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 最终数据集包含114项符合条件的研究中每项研究的30个编码条目，共计3,420个编码，并为20部锚定著作提供了相同的证据条目。 每项研究都附带指向支持其编码的章节、表格和图表的定位符。 数据集还记录了框架中173条记录的每一条的筛选决定、双编码样本的裁定结果，以及改进者比较的独立编码。

sents.en: The resulting dataset contains 30 coded items for each of the 114 eligible studies, 3,420 codes in all, and the same evidence items for the 20 anchor works.
sents.zh: 最终数据集包含114项符合条件的研究中每项研究的30个编码条目，共计3,420个编码，并为20部锚定著作提供了相同的证据条目。

sents.en: Each study carries locators to the sections, tables and figures that support its codes.
sents.zh: 每项研究都附带指向支持其编码的章节、表格和图表的定位符。

sents.en: The dataset also records the screening decision for each of the 173 records in the frame, the adjudication of the double-coded sample and the independent codes of the improver comparisons.
sents.zh: 数据集还记录了框架中173条记录的每一条的筛选决定、双编码样本的裁定结果，以及改进者比较的独立编码。

paragraphs.en: We piloted the codebook on 14 studies spanning harness, weight, data, improver, and evaluator updates, then froze the first version before full coding. The pilot established that evaluation separation must account for checkpoint and hyperparameter choice and that relevant evidence must be sought in appendices as well as the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖框架（harness）、权重、数据、改进器和评估器更新的 14 项研究上对编码手册进行了试点，然后在正式编码前冻结了第一版。 试点工作确定了评估分离必须考虑检查点和超参数的选择，并且相关证据必须在附录以及正文中寻找。

sents.en: We piloted the codebook on 14 studies spanning harness, weight, data, improver, and evaluator updates, then froze the first version before full coding.
sents.zh: 我们在涵盖框架（harness）、权重、数据、改进器和评估器更新的 14 项研究上对编码手册进行了试点，然后在正式编码前冻结了第一版。

sents.en: The pilot established that evaluation separation must account for checkpoint and hyperparameter choice and that relevant evidence must be sought in appendices as well as the main text.
sents.zh: 试点工作确定了评估分离必须考虑检查点和超参数的选择，并且相关证据必须在附录以及正文中寻找。

paragraphs.en: An LLM-based assistant supported the first coding pass by reading each full text, extracted from the PDF of the coded version, and proposing every code with a supporting locator. The later recodes were produced with the same assistance from passages retrieved from the same texts. Human coders reviewed the double-coded sample and the improver comparisons described below. No human reviewed the other codes individually.
paragraphs.zh: 一个基于大语言模型的助手辅助了第一轮编码，它阅读从已编码版本的 PDF 中提取的每篇全文，并为每一条编码提出一个支持性定位符。 后续的重新编码则在同样的辅助下，针对从相同文本中检索出的段落进行。 人类编码员审阅了双重编码样本以及下文所述的改进对比。 没有人类逐一审阅其余编码。

sents.en: An LLM-based assistant supported the first coding pass by reading each full text, extracted from the PDF of the coded version, and proposing every code with a supporting locator.
sents.zh: 一个基于大语言模型的助手辅助了第一轮编码，它阅读从已编码版本的 PDF 中提取的每篇全文，并为每一条编码提出一个支持性定位符。

sents.en: The later recodes were produced with the same assistance from passages retrieved from the same texts.
sents.zh: 后续的重新编码则在同样的辅助下，针对从相同文本中检索出的段落进行。

sents.en: Human coders reviewed the double-coded sample and the improver comparisons described below.
sents.zh: 人类编码员审阅了双重编码样本以及下文所述的改进对比。

sents.en: No human reviewed the other codes individually.
sents.zh: 没有人类逐一审阅其余编码。

paragraphs.en: An independent human coder, blind to the first-pass codes, then coded a random sample of 30 eligible studies. Agreement was high for the label, domain, changed artifact, improver claim, reported uncertainty, and audited reruns, with Cohen’s κ \kappa between 0.81 and 0.91. Agreement varied more for other evidence items (Table 16 ). The second coding was stricter about evaluation separation and more inclusive of null controls, per-round audits, and improver tests. We used these disagreements to clarify the decision rules in codebook v1.1 and recoded all eligible and anchor studies on the affected items.
paragraphs.zh: 一名独立的人类编码员在不知道第一轮编码结果的情况下，对随机抽取的 30 项符合条件的研究进行了编码。 在标签、领域、变更产物、改进者声明、报告的不确定性以及经审计的重跑结果方面，一致性很高，Cohen’s κ \kappa 介于 0.81 和 0.91 之间。 其他证据项目的一致性差异较大（表 16 ）。 第二轮编码在评估分离方面更为严格，对空对照、每轮审计和改进者测试的纳入范围更广。 我们利用这些分歧澄清了编码手册 v1.1 中的决策规则，并对所有符合条件的研究和锚定研究受影响的项目进行了重新编码。

sents.en: An independent human coder, blind to the first-pass codes, then coded a random sample of 30 eligible studies.
sents.zh: 一名独立的人类编码员在不知道第一轮编码结果的情况下，对随机抽取的 30 项符合条件的研究进行了编码。

sents.en: Agreement was high for the label, domain, changed artifact, improver claim, reported uncertainty, and audited reruns, with Cohen’s κ \kappa between 0.81 and 0.91.
sents.zh: 在标签、领域、变更产物、改进者声明、报告的不确定性以及经审计的重跑结果方面，一致性很高，Cohen’s κ \kappa 介于 0.81 和 0.91 之间。

sents.en: Agreement varied more for other evidence items (Table 16 ).
sents.zh: 其他证据项目的一致性差异较大（表 16 ）。

sents.en: The second coding was stricter about evaluation separation and more inclusive of null controls, per-round audits, and improver tests.
sents.zh: 第二轮编码在评估分离方面更为严格，对空对照、每轮审计和改进者测试的纳入范围更广。

sents.en: We used these disagreements to clarify the decision rules in codebook v1.1 and recoded all eligible and anchor studies on the affected items.
sents.zh: 我们利用这些分歧澄清了编码手册 v1.1 中的决策规则，并对所有符合条件的研究和锚定研究受影响的项目进行了重新编码。

paragraphs.en: A third reader then settled each of the 177 disagreements between the two codings from the full text. The reader saw both sets of codes without knowing their source, in an order randomized by paper, and every decision required a locator. The third reader upheld the human coding in 174 cases and the first pass in 3, so the first pass agreed with the adjudicated codes on 81% of the 900 coded cells. The AI-assisted first pass therefore erred substantially more often than the independent human coding, and we treat the adjudicated codes as the reference for the sample.
paragraphs.zh: 随后由第三位阅读者对两次编码在全文基础上产生的177处分歧逐一定夺。 该阅读者在不知道编码来源的情况下查看两组编码，顺序按论文随机排列，且每项决定都需附一个定位依据。 第三位阅读者在174例中维持人工编码，在3例中维持第一轮编码，因此第一轮编码与裁定后编码在900个编码单元格中的81%上达成一致。 因此，AI辅助的第一轮编码出错的频率远高于独立人工编码，我们将裁定后的编码作为该样本的参照标准。

sents.zh: 随后由第三位阅读者对两次编码在全文基础上产生的177处分歧逐一定夺。

sents.zh: 第三位阅读者在174例中维持人工编码，在3例中维持第一轮编码，因此第一轮编码与裁定后编码在900个编码单元格中的81%上达成一致。

sents.en: The AI-assisted first pass therefore erred substantially more often than the independent human coding, and we treat the adjudicated codes as the reference for the sample.
sents.zh: 因此，AI辅助的第一轮编码出错的频率远高于独立人工编码，我们将裁定后的编码作为该样本的参照标准。

paragraphs.en: Agreement statistics refer to the two blind codings before adjudication, because the revised rules were developed after examining their disagreements. Because the double-coded studies are a random sample, their adjudicated codes also estimate each headline share without relying on the first pass. Section 6.5 compares these estimates with the codes of the remaining studies.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性统计指的是裁决前的两次盲编码结果，因为修订后的规则是在分析它们的分歧之后制定的。 由于双重编码的研究是一个随机样本，其经裁决的编码也能在不依赖首轮编码的情况下估计各头条占比。 第6.5节将这些估计值与其余研究的编码进行比较。

sents.en: Agreement statistics refer to the two blind codings before adjudication, because the revised rules were developed after examining their disagreements.
sents.zh: 一致性统计指的是裁决前的两次盲编码结果，因为修订后的规则是在分析它们的分歧之后制定的。

sents.en: Section 6.5 compares these estimates with the codes of the remaining studies.
sents.zh: 第6.5节将这些估计值与其余研究的编码进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The census combines adjudicated codes for the 29 sampled studies that remain eligible with v1.1 codes for the other 85 eligible studies. Two subsequent revisions apply to all studies. The first (v1.2) responded to an external review of the codes. It added the design of each improver comparison and the reason for each partial separation, enforced the logical rules between items, and excluded one study whose loop was specified but never run. These additions were coded after adjudication.
paragraphs.zh: 普查结合了29项仍符合纳入条件的抽样研究经裁定后的编码，以及其余85项符合条件研究的v1.1编码。 随后的两次修订适用于所有研究。 第一次修订（v1.2）回应了对编码的一次外部审查。 它增加了每个改进型比较的设计和每次部分分离的原因，强化了条目之间的逻辑规则，并排除了一项虽指定了循环但从未运行的研究。 这些新增内容是在裁定之后编码的。

sents.en: The census combines adjudicated codes for the 29 sampled studies that remain eligible with v1.1 codes for the other 85 eligible studies.
sents.zh: 普查结合了29项仍符合纳入条件的抽样研究经裁定后的编码，以及其余85项符合条件研究的v1.1编码。

sents.en: Two subsequent revisions apply to all studies.
sents.zh: 随后的两次修订适用于所有研究。

sents.en: The first (v1.2) responded to an external review of the codes.
sents.zh: 第一次修订（v1.2）回应了对编码的一次外部审查。

sents.en: It added the design of each improver comparison and the reason for each partial separation, enforced the logical rules between items, and excluded one study whose loop was specified but never run.
sents.zh: 它增加了每个改进型比较的设计和每次部分分离的原因，强化了条目之间的逻辑规则，并排除了一项虽指定了循环但从未运行的研究。

sents.zh: 这些新增内容是在裁定之后编码的。

paragraphs.en: The second revision (v1.3) uses independent coding of the improver comparisons to answer RQ2. A coder who was blind to our codes assessed all 43 studies and anchor works that claim a better improver or had been coded with an improver-related comparison. The coder recorded the improver, whether a comparison exists and whether its budget is stated as matched, its design, its result and a locator.
paragraphs.zh: 第二次修订（v1.3）通过对改进者比较进行独立编码来回答 RQ2。 一位对我们的编码不知情的编码员评估了全部 43 项研究及锚定文献，这些研究声称存在更好的智能体改进者，或已被编码为包含智能体改进者相关的比较。 编码员记录了智能体改进者、是否存在比较、其预算是否声明为匹配、其设计、其结果以及定位信息。

sents.en: The second revision (v1.3) uses independent coding of the improver comparisons to answer RQ2.
sents.zh: 第二次修订（v1.3）通过对改进者比较进行独立编码来回答 RQ2。

sents.en: A coder who was blind to our codes assessed all 43 studies and anchor works that claim a better improver or had been coded with an improver-related comparison.
sents.zh: 一位对我们的编码不知情的编码员评估了全部 43 项研究及锚定文献，这些研究声称存在更好的智能体改进者，或已被编码为包含智能体改进者相关的比较。

sents.en: The coder recorded the improver, whether a comparison exists and whether its budget is stated as matched, its design, its result and a locator.
sents.zh: 编码员记录了智能体改进者、是否存在比较、其预算是否声明为匹配、其设计、其结果以及定位信息。

paragraphs.en: Before disagreements were resolved, the two codings agreed on the design for 81% of the studies ( κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ) and on the comparison code for 72% ( κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50 ). Of the 16 disagreements, 8 concerned only whether a budget was stated as matched (Table 17 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在分歧解决之前，两次编码在81%的研究（ κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ）的设计上以及72%的比较编码（ κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50 ）上是一致的。 在16处分歧中，有8处仅涉及预算是否被声明为匹配（表17）。

sents.en: Before disagreements were resolved, the two codings agreed on the design for 81% of the studies ( κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ) and on the comparison code for 72% ( κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50 ).
sents.zh: 在分歧解决之前，两次编码在81%的研究（ κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ）的设计上以及72%的比较编码（ κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50 ）上是一致的。

sents.en: Of the 16 disagreements, 8 concerned only whether a budget was stated as matched (Table 17 ).
sents.zh: 在16处分歧中，有8处仅涉及预算是否被声明为匹配（表17）。

paragraphs.en: We adopted the independent codes and then applied one rule more strictly than either coding had: a same-start comparison requires identical starting artifacts for everything except the improver, because equal scores do not imply equal states (Section 4 ). This rule reclassified two comparisons that both codings had counted as same-start.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采纳了独立编码的结果，并比任何一次编码都更严格地执行了一条规则：同起点的比较要求除改进器之外的一切起始工件都完全相同，因为分数相等并不意味着状态相等（第 4 节）。 这条规则将两次在两种编码中都被计为同起点的比较重新分类了。

sents.en: We adopted the independent codes and then applied one rule more strictly than either coding had: a same-start comparison requires identical starting artifacts for everything except the improver, because equal scores do not imply equal states (Section 4 ).
sents.zh: 我们采纳了独立编码的结果，并比任何一次编码都更严格地执行了一条规则：同起点的比较要求除改进器之外的一切起始工件都完全相同，因为分数相等并不意味着状态相等（第 4 节）。

sents.zh: 这条规则将两次在两种编码中都被计为同起点的比较重新分类了。

paragraphs.en: We report counts with their denominators. These counts summarize the recorded codes for the finite search frame. For the principal shares we add Wilson 95% intervals, which treat the studies as draws from the research practice that generates them. These intervals do not account for coding error or missed records, which are addressed through the robustness checks and the discussion of limitations (Sections 6.5 and 9 ). We compare studies posted before and from 1 September 2026 using Fisher’s exact test, with Newcombe 95% intervals for the differences in shares, and examine the alternative populations defined above. Because tasks, metrics, and budgets differ across studies, the analysis compares reported evaluation practices rather than pooling performance gains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在报告计数时同时给出其分母。 这些计数汇总了有限检索时间范围内所记录的编码。 对于主要占比，我们添加了 Wilson 95% 区间，这些区间将各研究视为产生它们的研究实践中的抽样。 这些区间未考虑编码错误或遗漏的记录，这些问题通过稳健性检验和局限性讨论（第 6.5 节和第 9 节）加以处理。 我们使用 Fisher 精确检验比较 2026 年 9 月 1 日之前发布与自该日起发布的研究，并使用 Newcombe 95% 区间表示占比差异，同时检验上文定义的备选研究总体。 由于各研究在任务、指标和预算上存在差异，本分析比较的是所报告的评估实践，而非汇总性能提升。

sents.zh: 我们在报告计数时同时给出其分母。

sents.en: These counts summarize the recorded codes for the finite search frame.
sents.zh: 这些计数汇总了有限检索时间范围内所记录的编码。

sents.en: Because tasks, metrics, and budgets differ across studies, the analysis compares reported evaluation practices rather than pooling performance gains.
sents.zh: 由于各研究在任务、指标和预算上存在差异，本分析比较的是所报告的评估实践，而非汇总性能提升。

paragraphs.en: We first examine whether reported evaluation designs address the claims made by RSI studies (RQ1), then analyze improver comparisons in detail (RQ2). The remaining results describe individual evaluation items and assess robustness to coding and population choices (RQ3). The central distinction is between widespread product evaluation and the less frequently reported designs needed to assess repeatability and improver gains. Unless stated otherwise, results refer to the 90 strong-label studies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先检验已报告的评估设计是否能够支持 RSI 研究所提出的主张（RQ1），然后详细分析改进器的比较（RQ2）。 其余结果描述各个评估条目，并评估对编码方式和人群选择的稳健性（RQ3）。 核心区别在于广泛的产品评估与评估可重复性和改进器增益所需的较少被报告的设计之间。 除非另有说明，结果均指这 90 项强标签研究。

sents.en: We first examine whether reported evaluation designs address the claims made by RSI studies (RQ1), then analyze improver comparisons in detail (RQ2).
sents.zh: 我们首先检验已报告的评估设计是否能够支持 RSI 研究所提出的主张（RQ1），然后详细分析改进器的比较（RQ2）。

sents.zh: 核心区别在于广泛的产品评估与评估可重复性和改进器增益所需的较少被报告的设计之间。

sents.en: Unless stated otherwise, results refer to the 90 strong-label studies.
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，结果均指这 90 项强标签研究。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 pairs each claim in Table 2 with the studies to which it applies. For C2 and C4 these are the studies that make the claim. C1 applies to every eligible study. We also report audited reruns and budget-matched comparators for every study as recommended practices, irrespective of its explicit claims. For each row, a strict indicator records the design closest to what the claim requires, and a broad indicator records related but weaker evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 表4将表2中的每项声明与其适用的研究进行配对。 对于C2和C4，这些是提出该声明的研究。 C1适用于每项符合条件的研究。 我们还将审计过的重跑和预算匹配的对照作为推荐做法报告给每项研究，无论其是否有明确声明。 对于每一行，一个严格指标记录最接近声明要求的设计，一个宽泛指标记录相关但较弱的证据。

sents.en: Table 4 pairs each claim in Table 2 with the studies to which it applies.
sents.zh: 表4将表2中的每项声明与其适用的研究进行配对。

sents.en: For C2 and C4 these are the studies that make the claim.
sents.zh: 对于C2和C4，这些是提出该声明的研究。

sents.en: C1 applies to every eligible study.
sents.zh: C1适用于每项符合条件的研究。

sents.en: We also report audited reruns and budget-matched comparators for every study as recommended practices, irrespective of its explicit claims.
sents.zh: 我们还将审计过的重跑和预算匹配的对照作为推荐做法报告给每项研究，无论其是否有明确声明。

sents.en: For each row, a strict indicator records the design closest to what the claim requires, and a broad indicator records related but weaker evidence.
sents.zh: 对于每一行，一个严格指标记录最接近声明要求的设计，一个宽泛指标记录相关但较弱的证据。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of the final product is widespread, but its independence is less secure than the broad rate suggests. The broad product-evaluation indicator covers 90% of studies, while 60% report tasks unused for any selection. The difference comprises studies that reuse evaluation tasks for selection, hold out only part of the headline result, or leave the separation unstated (Section 6.3 ). Among the 45 studies that claim accumulating gains, 60% audit across rounds or checkpoints. By contrast, repeated evaluation of the full loop is uncommon: only 22% of studies audit two or more reruns, and only 26% report more than one run at all. Most studies compare against some baseline (87%), but only 37% match its budget to that of the loop. Improver claims show the widest gap between related and identifying evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对最终产品的评估很普遍，但其独立性并不像宽泛比例所显示的那样可靠。 宽泛的产品评估指标覆盖了 90% 的研究，而 60% 的研究报告的任务未用于任何选择。 两者的差异包括将评估任务重复用于选择的研究、仅保留部分主要结果的研究，或未说明这种分离的研究（第 6.3 节）。 在声称能累积收益的 45 项研究中，60% 会在多轮或多个检查点之间进行审计。 相比之下，对完整循环的重复评估并不常见：只有 22% 的研究审计了两次或更多次重跑，且只有 26% 的研究报告了不止一次运行。 大多数研究都与某种基线进行了比较（87%），但只有 37% 的研究将其预算与循环的预算相匹配。 改进器的声明在相关证据与识别性证据之间显示出最宽的差距。

sents.zh: 对最终产品的评估很普遍，但其独立性并不像宽泛比例所显示的那样可靠。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 lists every strong-label study that claims a better improver, with the comparison that the independent coder recorded for it. Of the 26 claimants, 23 report an improver-related comparison, and in 22 of these the proposed process outperforms the comparison arm. However, the comparisons answer different questions. Only 4 (15%, interval 6–34) compare an earlier and a later improver from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. MetaRSI, for example, creates two copies of one released system and improves one with the original improver and the other with the meta-updated improver. Under the same budget and sealed data splits, the updated improver adds 7.2 points, compared with 4.9 for the original [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 表5列出了每一项声称拥有更优改进器的强标签研究，以及独立编码员为其记录的对照方式。 在26项声称者中，有23项报告了与改进器相关的对照，其中22项的提出流程优于对照臂。 然而，这些对照回答的是不同的问题。 只有4项（15%，区间6–34）在匹配的预算下，从相同的起始产物出发比较较早与较晚的改进器。 例如，MetaRSI对一个已发布系统创建两个副本，一个用原始改进器改进，另一个用元更新后的改进器改进。 在相同预算和封存的数据划分下，更新后的改进器提升了7.2分，而原始改进器为4.9分[ 8 ]。

sents.en: Under the same budget and sealed data splits, the updated improver adds 7.2 points, compared with 4.9 for the original [ 8 ] .

paragraphs.en: The studies span several forms of self-improvement. In 52 studies (58%), the modified artifact belongs to the system running the loop, such as its weights, harness, memory, or improver. Another 25 (28%) modify a component that the system subsequently uses, while 13 (14%) improve a separate target. Only 4 studies make exclusively task-local changes. Most operate in verifiable domains (65, 72%). The remaining 25 include open-ended outputs graded by humans or models.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究涵盖了多种形式的自我改进。 在52项研究（58%）中，被修改的制品属于运行该循环的系统本身，例如其权重、运行框架、记忆或改进器。 另有25项（28%）修改的是系统随后会使用的组件，而13项（14%）则改进一个独立的目标。 仅有4项研究只做出任务局部性的改动。 大多数在可验证的领域中运行（65项，72%）。 其余25项包括由人类或模型进行评分的开放式输出。

paragraphs.en: Across these settings, 81 studies (90%, 95% interval 82–95) meet the broad product-evaluation criterion (A2 = Y or P). Of these, 54 (60% of all 90, interval 50–70) report selection-independent evaluation, compared with 45% of the strong-label studies in the adjudicated sample (Section 6.5 ). Among the other 27 studies, 14 also use the evaluation tasks for selection, such as choosing a checkpoint or reporting the best observed score. Another 5 hold out only part of the headline result, and 8 do not state how the evaluation tasks relate to the loop. The remaining 9 studies report no evaluation beyond development tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些场景中，81 项研究（90%，95% 区间 82–95）满足广义的产品评估标准（A2 = Y 或 P）。 其中，54 项（占全部 90 项的 60%，区间 50–70）报告了与选择无关的评估，相比之下，经裁定样本中的强标签研究为 45%（第 6.5 节）。 在其余 27 项研究中，14 项还将评估任务用于选择，例如选择检查点（checkpoint）或报告观察到的最佳分数。 另有 5 项仅对部分主要结果做了留出，8 项未说明评估任务与该循环的关系。 剩余 9 项研究报告的评估未超出开发任务的范围。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 places these product-evaluation indicators alongside process evaluation and controls. Both forms of process evaluation are less common than the broad product indicator. Per-round audits, which include audits at scheduled checkpoints and held-out metrics of an updated component, appear in 39 studies (43%, interval 34–54), but only 10 (11%) pair development and audit scores for the same rounds. Audited reruns of the full loop appear in 20 (22%, interval 15–32). By comparison, 66 studies (73%) report only one loop run or do not specify the number of runs. These results distinguish evaluating the final product from assessing how gains develop across rounds or recur across runs.
paragraphs.zh: 图1将这些产品评估指标与过程评估及控制措施并列展示。 这两类过程评估都比宽泛的产品指标更为少见。 逐轮审计（包括在预定检查点进行的审计以及对更新组件的保留集指标评估）出现在39项研究中（43%，区间34–54），但只有10项（11%）对同一轮次的开发得分与审计得分进行了配对。 对完整循环进行审计式重跑的研究有20项（22%，区间15–32）。 相比之下，66项研究（73%）仅报告了一次循环运行，或未说明运行次数。 这些结果将评估最终产品与评估收益如何跨轮次累积或跨运行重复出现区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The controls address a further question: what accounts for the observed gain? A budget-matched comparator appears in 33 studies (37%, interval 27–47). Null controls, such as shuffled feedback or random acceptance, appear in 17 (19%, interval 12–28), and noise-aware promotion rules in 17 (19%). Only 6 report all three of a per-round audit, audited reruns, and a budget-matched comparator. These counts distinguish the availability of individual checks from their use together in one study.
paragraphs.zh: 对照组实验回答了另一个问题：是什么导致了观察到的收益？ 33 项研究（37%，区间 27–47）出现了预算匹配的对照。 空对照（如打乱反馈或随机接受）出现在 17 项研究（19%，区间 12–28）中，感知噪声的晋升规则出现在 17 项研究（19%）中。 只有 6 项研究同时报告了逐轮审计、审计后重跑和预算匹配对照这三项。 这些统计数字区分了单项检查措施的可得性与其在同一研究中的联合使用。

paragraphs.en: Accumulation claims deserve a closer look. Accumulation is claimed by 45 studies (50%). Of these, 27 audit across rounds or checkpoints, although 6 of them rely on a partly separated evaluation. Another 4 report only audited reruns, which test whether the endpoint repeats but not whether gains build over rounds, and 14 report neither. Only 7 pair development and audit scores for the same rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 「累积（Accumulation）」类主张值得更仔细的审视。 有 45 项研究（50%）声称实现了累积。 其中，27 项跨多轮或多检查点进行了审计，但其中 6 项依赖部分分离的评估。 另有 4 项仅报告了经过审计的重跑结果——这种做法只能检验终点是否可复现，而无法检验收益是否随轮次累积；还有 14 项两者皆未报告。 仅有 7 项将同一轮次的开发得分与审计得分配对呈现。

paragraphs.en: The relationship between stated and tested scope also varies. The census records scope gaps in 27 of the 90 strong-label studies (30%). Among the 22 strong-label studies in the adjudicated sample, the share is higher, at 55% (Section 6.5 ). This item compares the scope presented in the title, abstract, or introduction with the evaluated setting. Some authors explicitly distinguish the result they report from a stronger RSI ambition. AIDE 2 reports its improver comparison as inconclusive [ 12 ] , and Frontis-MA1 states that it does not yet realize RSI [ 95 ] . By contrast, Redwood describes a qualitative example as an early demonstration of RSI without quantitatively evaluating the improvement loop [ 96 ] . These examples show why the claim and the evaluation must be coded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 声明的范围与测试的范围之间的关系也不尽相同。 普查记录显示，在 90 项强标签研究中有 27 项（30%）存在范围差距。 在裁决样本的 22 项强标签研究中，这一比例更高，为 55%（第 6.5 节）。 该条目将标题、摘要或引言中呈现的范围与评估环境进行比较。 一些作者明确区分了他们报告的结果与更强的 RSI 目标。 AIDE 2 报告其改进器比较结果不确定 [ 12 ] ，而 Frontis-MA1 声明其尚未实现 RSI [ 95 ] 。 相比之下，Redwood 将一个定性例子描述为 RSI 的早期演示，但没有对改进循环进行定量评估 [ 96 ] 。 这些例子说明了为什么必须对声明和评估分别进行编码。
