paragraphs.en: Evaluation also depends on who supplies the scores. The development signal includes the actor’s own judgment in 20 studies (22%), and either self-judgment or a model judge in 34 (38%). In 14 studies, the system changes its own evaluator, rubric, or tests, and 8 report no fixed external reference governing those changes. These designs make grader provenance relevant to the interpretation of product and process results.
paragraphs.zh: 评估还取决于由谁来提供分数。 开发信号在 20 项研究（22%）中包含智能体自身的判断，在 34 项（38%）中为自我判断或模型评判二者之一。 在 14 项研究中，系统会更改自身的评估器、评分标准或测试，其中 8 项未报告任何约束这些更改的固定外部参照。 这些设计使评分者的来源与产品和过程结果的解读密切相关。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports evaluation graders by domain. Verifiable-domain studies predominantly use executable checks or reference labels. Among the 25 open or mixed-domain studies, the audit is graded by human raters alone in 1, by a model judge alone in 4, and by a combination of graders in 15. The other 5 report no audit beyond the development tasks. Mixed designs include labels with a model judge, preference scores with a user study, and panels containing the system’s own evaluator. Human raters, judges from another family and executable tests can all share errors with the development signal, and Proposition 2 shows how such shared errors bias the audited gain. Some studies introduce explicit reference checks: the Red Queen Gödel Machine evaluates replacement graders against fixed objective or human labels [ 14 ] , while RRI uses adversarial search to identify and repair hackable rubrics [ 82 ] .

paragraphs.en: RQ3 asks whether these findings depend on the coding or on the study population. The double-coded studies are a random sample of the eligible studies, so their adjudicated codes give an estimate of each headline share that does not rest on the AI-assisted first pass. Table 8 reports these estimates for the 29 sampled studies that remain eligible, together with the first-pass codes for the same studies and the codes of the other 85 eligible studies.

paragraphs.en: In the adjudicated sample, selection-independent evaluation remains more common than audited reruns, at 41% against 14%: within the same studies, 10 report the first without the second and 2 the reverse (exact paired p = 0.04 p=0.04 ). The broad product indicator, at 83% (interval 65–92), exceeds every process item, while selection-independent evaluation is about as common as per-round audits at 45% ( p = 1.00 p=1.00 ) and budget-matched comparators at 34% ( p = 0.73 p=0.73 ). The 22 strong-label studies in the sample show the same pattern, with selection-independent evaluation in 45% and audited reruns in 14% ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 ). Human coding therefore supports a gap in audited reruns. The independent improver coding identifies a separate gap in same-start comparisons (Section 6.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在经过裁决的样本中，与评估者选择无关的评估仍比经审计的重跑更为常见，比例为41%对14%：在同一批研究中，10项报告了前者而未报告后者，2项则相反（精确配对 p = 0.04 p=0.04 ）。 广义产品指标为83%（区间65–92），高于每一项过程指标，而与评估者选择无关的评估与逐轮审计的发生率大致相当，为45%（ p = 1.00 p=1.00 ），预算匹配的对照为34%（ p = 0.73 p=0.73 ）。 样本中的22项强标签研究呈现相同的模式，与评估者选择无关的评估占45%，经审计的重跑占14%（ p = 0.04 p=0.04 ）。 因此，人工编码证实了经审计的重跑方面存在缺口。 独立改进者编码则识别出同起点比较方面的另一个缺口（第6.2节）。

paragraphs.en: Comparing the adjudicated sample with the remaining studies assesses whether the headline shares are sensitive to the AI-assisted coding. For no process item does the share among the other studies differ significantly from the adjudicated share (smallest p = 0.17 p=0.17 ). The largest gaps concern null controls, recorded in 15% of the other studies against 28% of the sample, and matched improver comparisons, at 15% against 28%. The census may therefore undercount null controls. For improver comparisons, both groups use the independent coding.
paragraphs.zh: 将裁定的样本与其余研究进行比较，可以评估头条份额对AI辅助编码是否敏感。 对于任何流程条目，其余研究中的份额与裁定份额均无显著差异（最小 p = 0.17 p=0.17）。 差距最大的是零假设对照和其他匹配改进者比较：前者在其余研究中占15%，而在样本中占28%；后者分别为15%和28%。 因此，该普查可能低估了零假设对照的数量。 在改进者比较方面，两组均使用独立编码。

paragraphs.en: The product indicators show a consistent directional difference. Compared with the adjudicated codes, the codes outside the sample record fully or partly held-out evaluation more often (94% versus 83%), selection-independent evaluation more often (64% versus 41%, p = 0.05 p=0.05 ), and headline results based on the development signal less often (28% versus 45%). They also record a scope gap far less often (19% versus 55%, p < 0.01 p<0.01 ).
paragraphs.zh: 产品指标显示出一致的方向性差异。 与裁定编码相比，样本记录之外的编码更常完整或部分记录了留出评估（94% 对 83%），更常记录与选择无关的评估（64% 对 41%，p = 0.05 p=0.05），更少记录基于开发信号的主要结果（28% 对 45%）。 它们也更少记录范围差距（19% 对 55%，p < 0.01 p<0.01）。

sents.en: The product indicators show a consistent directional difference.
sents.zh: 产品指标显示出一致的方向性差异。

paragraphs.en: These comparisons suggest that the census overstates product evaluation, particularly its independence from selection, and understates how often the stated scope exceeds the tested one. These differences make product evidence look stronger in the census than in the adjudicated sample. Apart from the scope gap (31% versus 55%) and matched improver comparisons, which use the independent coding, the v1.1 codes of the sampled studies match the adjudicated shares closely. However, they were revised after the second coding of these same studies, so they do not show how accurate v1.1 is elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 这些对比表明，普查夸大了产品评估，尤其是其独立于选择的一面，同时低估了所述范围超出受测范围的频率。 这些差异使产品证据在普查中显得比在裁定样本中更强。 除范围差距（31% 对 55%）以及使用独立编码的匹配改进型对比外，抽样研究的 v1.1 编码与裁定后的占比相当接近。 然而，这些编码是在对相同研究进行第二次编码之后修订的，因此它们无法表明 v1.1 在其他地方的准确性。

paragraphs.en: The anchor works provide a complementary comparison (Figure 1 ; Table 18 in Appendix D ). Fully or partly held-out product evaluation appears in 95% of these works, compared with 30% for per-round audits, 25% for audited reruns, and 20% for budget-matched comparators. In addition, 20% report a null control, while none uses a noise-aware promotion rule. Of the 8 works claiming a better improver, 7 report an improver-related comparison at a matched budget, but only STOP compares an earlier and a later improver from identical starting artifacts. These established works show a similar pattern beyond the RSI search frame.
paragraphs.zh: 这些锚定工作提供了互补性的对比（图 1；附录 D 中的表 18）。 95% 的这些工作包含了完全或部分留出的产品评估，相比之下，逐轮审计为 30%，经审计的重跑为 25%，预算匹配的对照为 20%。 此外，20% 的工作报告了零对照，而没有任何一项使用噪声感知的提升规则。 在声称拥有更好改进器的 8 项工作中，有 7 项在匹配预算下报告了与改进器相关的对比，但只有 STOP 在相同的起始工件上对比了早期和晚期的改进器。 在 RSI 搜索框架之外，这些已确立的工作呈现出相似的模式。

paragraphs.en: For eight anchor works, we also compare our codes with the protocol descriptions in Wu et al. [17] (Table 20 ). The descriptions and codes agree in 20 of 24 cells: 6 of 8 for test separation, 6 of 8 for improver tests, and 8 of 8 for budget parity. The 2 test-separation disagreements concern ADAS’s choice of transfer agents by test accuracy [ 2 ] and Meta-Rewarding’s comparison of length-control settings on its reported benchmark [ 13 ] . The other two disagreements concern improver tests. Wu et al. list no improver test for Meta-Rewarding, whereas we record its comparison with Self-Rewarding at equal prompt and iteration counts as another improver-related comparison, which counts as partial. For Promptbreeder [ 97 ] , the independent coder records the ablation with frozen mutation prompts as matched in population and evaluations, whereas Wu et al. describe it as an operator ablation, which implies a partial code.
paragraphs.zh: 对于八篇锚定文献，我们还将我们的编码与 Wu 等人 [17] 中的协议描述进行了比较（表 20）。 描述与编码在 24 个单元格中的 20 个上一致：测试分离为 8 个中的 6 个，改进者测试为 8 个中的 6 个，预算对等为 8 个中的 8 个。 两处测试分离的不一致涉及 ADAS 按测试准确率选择迁移智能体 [2]，以及 Meta-Rewarding 在其报告的基准上对长度控制设置的比较 [13]。 另外两处不一致涉及改进者测试。 Wu 等人未列出 Meta-Rewarding 的改进者测试，而我们将其在相同提示和迭代次数下与 Self-Rewarding 的比较记录为另一项与改进者相关的比较，计为部分符合。 对于 Promptbreeder [97]，独立编码者将冻结变异提示的消融记录为在种群和评估上匹配，而 Wu 等人将其描述为算子消融，这意味着部分编码。

paragraphs.en: A temporal comparison separates the 64 strong-label studies posted from 1 September 2026 from the 26 posted earlier. Selection-independent evaluation appears in 66% versus 46%; per-round audits or audited reruns in 52% versus 50%; budget-matched comparators in 41% versus 27%; and audited reruns in 25% versus 15%. The largest difference is in selection-independent evaluation, 19 percentage points in favor of the later cohort (95% interval − 3 -3 to 40 40 ).
paragraphs.zh: 时间对比将 2026 年 9 月 1 日之后发布的 64 项强标签研究与此前发布的 26 项研究区分开来。 与选择无关的评估在两者中分别占 66% 与 46%；逐轮审计或经审计的重跑分别占 52% 与 50%；预算匹配的对照分别占 41% 与 27%；经审计的重跑分别占 25% 与 15%。 差异最大的是与选择无关的评估，后期队列高出 19 个百分点（95% 区间为 −3 至 40）。

paragraphs.en: Fisher’s exact tests do not detect a difference on any of the four indicators (smallest p = 0.10 p=0.10 ), but the intervals are wide. All four point estimates favor the later cohort, by 2 to 19 points, so the data are compatible both with stable practice and with a substantial improvement during the increase in RSI publications.
paragraphs.zh: Fisher精确检验在四项指标上均未检测到差异（最小 p = 0.10 p=0.10），但置信区间很宽。 四项点估计值均偏向较晚的队列，相差2至19个百分点，因此数据既与稳定的实践相容，也与RSI论文数量增加期间的显著改进相容。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the shares are similar under alternative eligibility subsets. Among all 114 eligible studies, 91% report fully or partly held-out product evaluation, 40% a per-round audit, 22% audited reruns, 32% a budget-matched comparator, and 11% E4. For the 68 strong-label studies with the phrase in the title, the corresponding shares are 90%, 47%, 22%, 37%, and 15%. Domain differences are reported in Table 14 in Appendix D . The following section examines what individual studies show about the practical consequences of these evaluation distinctions.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，在替代的合格子集下，各份额相近。 在全部 114 项合格研究中，91% 报告了完全或部分保留的产品评估，40% 报告了逐轮审计，22% 报告了审计后的重跑，32% 报告了预算匹配的对照物，11% 报告了 E4。 对于标题中含该短语的 68 项强标签研究，相应的份额分别为 90%、47%、22%、37% 和 15%。 领域差异报告于附录 D 的表 14 中。 下一节将考察个别研究揭示了这些评估差异在实践中产生何种后果。

paragraphs.en: The census measures how often evaluation designs are reported. This section examines what these designs show by comparing development and audit outcomes within individual studies. In 24 eligible studies, including 22 with the strong label, the authors report development gains that transfer only partly, or not at all, to an audit (P5 = Y or P). Table 15 in Appendix D collects these cases. They document several forms of divergence.
paragraphs.zh: 该普查统计了评估设计的报告频率。 本节通过比较单项研究中的开发与审计结果，考察这些设计显示了什么。 在24项符合条件的研究中，包括22项带有强标签的研究，作者报告的开发收益只能部分迁移到审计，或完全无法迁移（P5 = Y 或 P）。 附录D中的表15汇集了这些案例。 它们记录了多种形式的分歧。

sents.en: The census measures how often evaluation designs are reported.
sents.zh: 该普查统计了评估设计的报告频率。

sents.en: This section examines what these designs show by comparing development and audit outcomes within individual studies.
sents.zh: 本节通过比较单项研究中的开发与审计结果，考察这些设计显示了什么。

sents.zh: 在24项符合条件的研究中，包括22项带有强标签的研究，作者报告的开发收益只能部分迁移到审计，或完全无法迁移（P5 = Y 或 P）。

sents.en: Table 15 in Appendix D collects these cases.
sents.zh: 附录D中的表15汇集了这些案例。

sents.en: They document several forms of divergence.
sents.zh: 它们记录了多种形式的分歧。

paragraphs.en: In 11, the development signal and the audit disagree about the same systems: one rises or ranks candidates while the other stays flat, falls, or ranks them differently. In 5, the audit confirms a smaller gain or the gain does not carry to a shifted domain. In 7, audited gains reverse in later rounds or fail to replicate across runs, and in one the audit itself was compromised. In 6 of the cases, the divergence concerns an ablation, a baseline or an unpromoted candidate rather than the proposed method.
paragraphs.zh: 在 11 例中，开发信号与审计对同一批系统给出不一致的结果：一方上升或对候选排序靠前，而另一方持平、下降或给出不同的排序。 在 5 例中，审计仅确认较小的提升，或该提升无法迁移到偏移后的领域。 在 7 例中，经审计的提升在后续轮次中反转或无法在多次运行间复现，其中一例是审计本身受到了破坏。 在 6 例中，分歧涉及的是消融实验、基线或未被提升的候选，而非所提出的方法。

paragraphs.en: The availability of paired outcomes determines which cases can be examined. Most studies do not report development and audit scores in a form that would show a divergence: 64 of the 90 strong-label studies are coded P5 = NA. We examine the cases alongside improver tests and scope comparisons, and we also discuss a few examples, such as grader dependence, that the divergence item does not count.
paragraphs.zh: 成对结果的可获得性决定了可以考察哪些案例。 大多数研究并未以能够显示偏差的形式报告开发分数与审计分数：90 项强标签研究中有 64 项被编码为 P5 = NA。 我们结合改进者测试与范围比较来考察这些案例，并且还讨论了一些偏差项未计入的例子，例如对评分器的依赖。

paragraphs.en: The robotics loop of Wang [16] accepted a change only after it passed replays, paired trials on fresh scenes and a held-out task. Yet the target task never succeeded over 123 rounds. The reach evaluator used a spherical boundary, and the agent learned to stop exactly on its surface. The authors report about two human repairs to the harness for every accepted skill change.
paragraphs.zh: Wang [16] 的机器人闭环系统只有在变更通过重放、新场景上的成对试验以及留出任务后才会接受它。 然而在 123 轮中，目标任务始终未能成功。 抓取评估器使用球形边界，智能体学会了恰好停在球面上。 作者报告，每接受一次技能变更，大约需要对测试框架进行两次人工修复。

sents.zh: Wang [16] 的机器人闭环系统只有在变更通过重放、新场景上的成对试验以及留出任务后才会接受它。

sents.en: Yet the target task never succeeded over 123 rounds.
sents.zh: 然而在 123 轮中，目标任务始终未能成功。

paragraphs.en: Other studies report partial transfer or regression across rounds. In ECG-RSI [ 9 ] , the error rate on the feedback set fell from 39.63% to 21.33% across three rounds, while successive gains on seven external benchmarks shrank from 13.07 to 3.01 to 0.38 points. Three benchmarks regressed in the last round.
paragraphs.zh: 其他研究报告称在多轮之间仅出现部分迁移或出现退步。 在 ECG-RSI [ 9 ] 中，反馈集上的错误率在三轮内从 39.63% 降至 21.33%，而在七个外部基准上的逐轮增益则从 13.07 点缩小到 3.01 点再到 0.38 点。 三个基准在最后一轮出现了退步。

sents.en: Other studies report partial transfer or regression across rounds.
sents.zh: 其他研究报告称在多轮之间仅出现部分迁移或出现退步。

sents.en: In ECG-RSI [ 9 ] , the error rate on the feedback set fell from 39.63% to 21.33% across three rounds, while successive gains on seven external benchmarks shrank from 13.07 to 3.01 to 0.38 points.
sents.zh: 在 ECG-RSI [ 9 ] 中，反馈集上的错误率在三轮内从 39.63% 降至 21.33%，而在七个外部基准上的逐轮增益则从 13.07 点缩小到 3.01 点再到 0.38 点。

paragraphs.en: RRSI [ 3 ] shows the pattern across methods. Prior methods for evolving harnesses transferred little of their gain on development tasks to out-of-distribution evaluation. The arm without RRSI’s regularizers reached the highest evolution score of any arm, 92.8, while its out-of-distribution average, 40.3, stayed within a point of the unevolved harness. The Mendel Gödel Machine reports a similar reduction in gains for coding agents [ 98 ] . Evolution raised accuracy on its 60 Polyglot evolution tasks from 50.8% to 93.2%, while the resulting scaffold, frozen for evaluation, gained 10.0 and 13.3 points on held-out SWE-bench Pro and SWE-bench Multilingual. The scaffold evolved by its HGM baseline lost 3.4 points on SWE-bench Pro.
paragraphs.zh: RRSI [ 3 ] 展示了各方法之间的模式。 此前用于演化测试框架的方法，其在开发任务上获得的收益几乎无法迁移到分布外评估中。 没有 RRSI 正则化项的分支达到了所有分支中最高的演化分数 92.8，而其分布外平均分 40.3 与未演化的测试框架相差不到一分。 Mendel Gödel Machine 也报告了编码智能体收益的类似下降 [ 98 ] 。 演化将其 60 个 Polyglot 演化任务上的准确率从 50.8% 提升到 93.2%，而由此得到并被冻结用于评估的脚手架，在留出的 SWE-bench Pro 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上分别获得了 10.0 分和 13.3 分。 其 HGM 基线演化出的脚手架在 SWE-bench Pro 上损失了 3.4 分。

paragraphs.en: A more direct disagreement between development and audit scores appears in R 2 Flow: most edits admitted on reward-derived labels raised the training reward while lowering the held-out verified score [ 99 ] . VideoHarness-SRSI documents a baseline whose validation accuracy keeps rising over rounds while accuracy on held-out questions does not [ 100 ] , and RecurSE describes a related effect as validation deception [ 90 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 开发分数与审计分数之间更直接的分歧出现在 R 2 Flow 中：大多数基于奖励派生标签被采纳的编辑在提高训练奖励的同时降低了留出验证分数 [ 99 ] 。 VideoHarness-SRSI 记录了一个基线，其验证准确率在多轮中持续上升，而在留出问题上的准确率并未上升 [ 100 ] ；RecurSE 将类似效应描述为验证欺骗 [ 90 ] 。

sents.en: A more direct disagreement between development and audit scores appears in R 2 Flow: most edits admitted on reward-derived labels raised the training reward while lowering the held-out verified score [ 99 ] .
sents.zh: 开发分数与审计分数之间更直接的分歧出现在 R 2 Flow 中：大多数基于奖励派生标签被采纳的编辑在提高训练奖励的同时降低了留出验证分数 [ 99 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Longer runs can also show a performance peak followed by regression: DataFoundry is best after two rounds, and its Finance score falls from 66.1 to 58.3 after one more [ 101 ] , while DA-RSIR peaks at round 4 [ 102 ] . In EvoAudio, a candidate that gains on the held-out promotion set “does not always gain on the benchmarks” [ 103 ] . A-Evolve-Training used a public leaderboard inside its loop. Its development metric reached record highs without improving the external target, and its authors do not interpret the result as evidence of RSI [ 104 ] . These cases motivate measuring development and audit outcomes together rather than inferring one from the other.
paragraphs.zh: 更长的运行还可能表现出先达到性能峰值随后退化的情况：DataFoundry 在两轮后最佳，再多进行一轮后其 Finance 得分从 66.1 降至 58.3 [ 101 ]，而 DA-RSIR 则在第 4 轮达到峰值 [ 102 ]。 在 EvoAudio 中，某个候选在留出的推广集上取得提升后，“并不总是在基准测试上取得提升” [ 103 ]。 A-Evolve-Training 在其循环内使用了公开排行榜。 其开发指标创下新高，但并未改善外部目标，其作者也没有将这一结果解释为 RSI 的证据 [ 104 ]。 这些案例说明应当同时测量开发与审计结果，而不是由其中一个推断另一个。

paragraphs.en: Variation between runs adds another evaluation question. Proposition 1 describes how selecting the best noisy score can inflate a reported gain, and two studies examine this selection effect. In Athanor, the first evaluation seed exceeded the mean of later seeds for 19 of 23 re-evaluated best candidates (sign test p = 0.003 p=0.003 ) [ 105 ] . MedForge-RSI pre-registered its configurations and found that the best single-run result often failed to replicate across seeds [ 106 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 多次运行之间的差异带来了另一个评估问题。 命题 1 描述了选择最佳含噪分数会如何夸大所报告的提升，有两项研究考察了这种选择效应。 在 Athanor 中，23 个重新评估的最佳候选里，有 19 个的首个评估种子结果高于后续种子的均值（符号检验 p = 0.003 p=0.003 ）[ 105 ] 。 MedForge-RSI 预先注册了其配置，并发现单次运行的最佳结果往往无法在不同种子间复现 [ 106 ] 。

sents.en: Variation between runs adds another evaluation question.
sents.zh: 多次运行之间的差异带来了另一个评估问题。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks designed to study improvement loops report related effects. In RSIBench-Data, 78.26% of agent searches that continued past their best score ended on a lower final attempt [ 59 ] , and in a controlled study of skill evolution, 9 of 11 validation-selected skills improved released-test performance [ 64 ] . These results motivate reporting variation across full loop runs, separately from evaluation variation for one evolved system.
paragraphs.zh: 旨在研究改进循环的基准测试报告了相关的效应。 在 RSIBench-Data 中，78.26% 超过其最佳分数后仍继续搜索的智能体最终一次尝试的结果更低 [ 59 ] ；在一项关于技能演化的受控研究中，11 个经验证筛选出的技能中有 9 个提升了发布测试的性能 [ 64 ] 。 这些结果促使我们报告完整循环运行中的变异，并将其与单个演化系统的评估变异分开。

sents.en: Benchmarks designed to study improvement loops report related effects.
sents.zh: 旨在研究改进循环的基准测试报告了相关的效应。

sents.en: In RSIBench-Data, 78.26% of agent searches that continued past their best score ended on a lower final attempt [ 59 ] , and in a controlled study of skill evolution, 9 of 11 validation-selected skills improved released-test performance [ 64 ] .
sents.zh: 在 RSIBench-Data 中，78.26% 超过其最佳分数后仍继续搜索的智能体最终一次尝试的结果更低 [ 59 ] ；在一项关于技能演化的受控研究中，11 个经验证筛选出的技能中有 9 个提升了发布测试的性能 [ 64 ] 。

sents.en: These results motivate reporting variation across full loop runs, separately from evaluation variation for one evolved system.
sents.zh: 这些结果促使我们报告完整循环运行中的变异，并将其与单个演化系统的评估变异分开。

paragraphs.en: A separate concern arises when development and audit graders share errors. In the self-play study introduced in Section 1 , the judge’s pass rate rises from 0.72 to 0.94 while hidden exact-match accuracy remains at 0.20 across three seeds [ 15 ] . Judges from other model families and a strict three-judge ensemble also accept many of the policy’s errors. This study lies outside the search frame but illustrates the shared-error mechanism in Proposition 2 . Self-preference persists even under objective rubrics [ 107 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当开发评分器与审计评分器共享错误时，会产生另一个值得关注的问题。 在第 1 节介绍的自博弈研究中，裁判的通过率从 0.72 上升到 0.94，而隐藏的精确匹配准确率在三个随机种子下始终保持在 0.20 [ 15 ] 。 来自其他模型家族的裁判以及严格的三裁判集成也接受了该策略的许多错误。 这项研究位于搜索框架之外，但说明了命题 2 中的共享错误机制。 即使在客观评分标准下，自我偏好依然存在 [ 107 ] 。

sents.en: A separate concern arises when development and audit graders share errors.
sents.zh: 当开发评分器与审计评分器共享错误时，会产生另一个值得关注的问题。

sents.en: In the self-play study introduced in Section 1 , the judge’s pass rate rises from 0.72 to 0.94 while hidden exact-match accuracy remains at 0.20 across three seeds [ 15 ] .
sents.zh: 在第 1 节介绍的自博弈研究中，裁判的通过率从 0.72 上升到 0.94，而隐藏的精确匹配准确率在三个随机种子下始终保持在 0.20 [ 15 ] 。

sents.en: Judges from other model families and a strict three-judge ensemble also accept many of the policy’s errors.
sents.zh: 来自其他模型家族的裁判以及严格的三裁判集成也接受了该策略的许多错误。

sents.en: This study lies outside the search frame but illustrates the shared-error mechanism in Proposition 2 .
sents.zh: 这项研究位于搜索框架之外，但说明了命题 2 中的共享错误机制。

sents.en: Self-preference persists even under objective rubrics [ 107 ] .
sents.zh: 即使在客观评分标准下，自我偏好依然存在 [ 107 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Within the frame, RSIAgent reports that its internal verifier agent returned PASS where the official rubric failed [ 108 ] . In the Red Queen Gödel Machine [ 14 ] , each change of evaluator is checked against a fixed reference, but the writers and provers are scored by panels that include the system’s own co-evolved reviewer or grader. Without its own grader in the panel, the evolved prover matches a human-engineered baseline (4.03 versus 4.08) rather than exceeding it.
paragraphs.zh: 在该框架内，RSIAgent 报告其内部验证者智能体返回了 PASS，而官方评分标准却判定未通过 [ 108 ] 。 在红皇后哥德尔机 [ 14 ] 中，评估器的每次变更都会对照一个固定参考进行检验，但写入者和证明者却由包含系统自身共同演化出的审阅者或评分者的评审小组来打分。 若评审小组中没有自己的评分者，演化出的证明者只能与人工设计的基线持平（4.03 对 4.08），而非超越它。

sents.en: Within the frame, RSIAgent reports that its internal verifier agent returned PASS where the official rubric failed [ 108 ] .
sents.zh: 在该框架内，RSIAgent 报告其内部验证者智能体返回了 PASS，而官方评分标准却判定未通过 [ 108 ] 。

sents.zh: 若评审小组中没有自己的评分者，演化出的证明者只能与人工设计的基线持平（4.03 对 4.08），而非超越它。

paragraphs.en: MASS [ 76 ] illustrates a related dependence: one model acts as agent, evaluator and optimizer. Its synthetic tasks were generated by a model that is also one of the two external judges, and its judge-graded gains are accompanied by flat results on two benchmarks with executable tests.
paragraphs.zh: MASS [76] 展示了一种类似的依赖关系：同一个模型同时充当智能体、评估器和优化器。 其合成任务由一个模型生成，而该模型同时也是两个外部评审之一；此外，尽管其由评审打分的成绩有所提升，但在两个带有可执行测试的基准上结果却持平。

sents.en: MASS [ 76 ] illustrates a related dependence: one model acts as agent, evaluator and optimizer.
sents.zh: MASS [76] 展示了一种类似的依赖关系：同一个模型同时充当智能体、评估器和优化器。

sents.en: Its synthetic tasks were generated by a model that is also one of the two external judges, and its judge-graded gains are accompanied by flat results on two benchmarks with executable tests.
sents.zh: 其合成任务由一个模型生成，而该模型同时也是两个外部评审之一；此外，尽管其由评审打分的成绩有所提升，但在两个带有可执行测试的基准上结果却持平。

paragraphs.en: Other studies introduce reference checks to separate evaluation from the development judge. SpecForge [ 109 ] searches against tests that the model generates and evaluates on ground-truth tests hidden from the search, and MedRSI [ 110 ] validates its clinical-consequence judge against adjudicated references and then freezes it.
paragraphs.zh: 其他研究引入参考核查，将评估与开发评判者分离开来。 SpecForge [ 109 ] 在模型生成的测试上进行搜索，并在搜索过程中不可见的真实标准测试上进行评估；MedRSI [ 110 ] 先对照经裁决的参考来验证其临床后果评判者，然后将其冻结。

sents.en: Other studies introduce reference checks to separate evaluation from the development judge.
sents.zh: 其他研究引入参考核查，将评估与开发评判者分离开来。

sents.en: SpecForge [ 109 ] searches against tests that the model generates and evaluates on ground-truth tests hidden from the search, and MedRSI [ 110 ] validates its clinical-consequence judge against adjudicated references and then freezes it.
sents.zh: SpecForge [ 109 ] 在模型生成的测试上进行搜索，并在搜索过程中不可见的真实标准测试上进行评估；MedRSI [ 110 ] 先对照经裁决的参考来验证其临床后果评判者，然后将其冻结。

paragraphs.en: Grader validation addresses how outcomes are scored, whereas improver tests address what produces them. Among self-modifying coding agents, an agent’s own benchmark score can diverge from the performance of the descendants it produces [ 72 ] , illustrating the distinction between solver performance and improvement ability. The designs distinguished in Section 6.2 make this difference testable.
paragraphs.zh: 评分器验证关注的是结果如何被评分，而改进器测试关注的是什么产生了这些结果。 在自我修改的编码智能体中，智能体自身的基准测试得分可能与其产生的后代的表现不一致 [ 72 ]，这说明了求解性能与改进能力之间的区别。 第 6.2 节中区分的设计使这一差异可以被测试。

sents.en: Grader validation addresses how outcomes are scored, whereas improver tests address what produces them.
sents.zh: 评分器验证关注的是结果如何被评分，而改进器测试关注的是什么产生了这些结果。

sents.en: Among self-modifying coding agents, an agent’s own benchmark score can diverge from the performance of the descendants it produces [ 72 ] , illustrating the distinction between solver performance and improvement ability.
sents.zh: 在自我修改的编码智能体中，智能体自身的基准测试得分可能与其产生的后代的表现不一致 [ 72 ]，这说明了求解性能与改进能力之间的区别。

sents.en: The designs distinguished in Section 6.2 make this difference testable.
sents.zh: 第 6.2 节中区分的设计使这一差异可以被测试。

paragraphs.en: A same-start comparison runs an earlier and a later improver from identical starting artifacts. STOP measures the improver of each iteration on the same held-out tasks and initial solutions [ 10 ] , and Sivia applies its initial and its learned updater to the same parent skill [ 75 ] . The result of such a comparison depends on its conditions: STOP’s self-improved improver helps with GPT-4 but not with GPT-3.5 or Mixtral.
paragraphs.zh: 同起点比较让早期改进器与后期改进器从完全相同的初始工件出发运行。 STOP 在相同的留出任务和初始解上衡量每次迭代的改进器 [ 10 ]，而 Sivia 将其初始更新器和学习到的更新器应用于同一个父技能 [ 75 ]。 这类比较的结果取决于其条件：STOP 自我改进后的改进器对 GPT-4 有效，但对 GPT-3.5 或 Mixtral 无效。

sents.en: A same-start comparison runs an earlier and a later improver from identical starting artifacts.
sents.zh: 同起点比较让早期改进器与后期改进器从完全相同的初始工件出发运行。

sents.en: STOP measures the improver of each iteration on the same held-out tasks and initial solutions [ 10 ] , and Sivia applies its initial and its learned updater to the same parent skill [ 75 ] .
sents.zh: STOP 在相同的留出任务和初始解上衡量每次迭代的改进器 [ 10 ]，而 Sivia 将其初始更新器和学习到的更新器应用于同一个父技能 [ 75 ]。

sents.en: The result of such a comparison depends on its conditions: STOP’s self-improved improver helps with GPT-4 but not with GPT-3.5 or Mixtral.
sents.zh: 这类比较的结果取决于其条件：STOP 自我改进后的改进器对 GPT-4 有效，但对 GPT-3.5 或 Mixtral 无效。

paragraphs.en: A direct comparison can also yield an inconclusive result. AIDE 2 runs a discovered agent and the human-engineered agent as outer-loop improvers from the same start, three seeds each. The arms end at 0.780 and 0.782, and the authors report the result as inconclusive [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 直接对比也可能得出不确定的结果。 AIDE 2 让一个被发现的智能体与人工设计的智能体从同一起点作为外循环改进器运行，各三个随机种子。 两条分支分别终止于 0.780 和 0.782，作者将该结果报告为不确定 [ 12 ] 。

sents.en: A direct comparison can also yield an inconclusive result.
sents.zh: 直接对比也可能得出不确定的结果。

sents.en: AIDE 2 runs a discovered agent and the human-engineered agent as outer-loop improvers from the same start, three seeds each.
sents.zh: AIDE 2 让一个被发现的智能体与人工设计的智能体从同一起点作为外循环改进器运行，各三个随机种子。

sents.en: The arms end at 0.780 and 0.782, and the authors report the result as inconclusive [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: 两条分支分别终止于 0.780 和 0.782，作者将该结果报告为不确定 [ 12 ] 。

paragraphs.en: An evolving-versus-frozen comparison evaluates the whole loop under two conditions, allowing the improver to change in one and holding it fixed in the other, as in the Darwin Gödel Machine [ 1 ] and Hyperagents [ 11 ] . It tests whether letting the improver change helps over a run, but because the two arms visit different states, it does not by itself show that a later improver beats an earlier one at a common state.
paragraphs.zh: 演化对比冻结的评估方式在两种条件下评估整个循环：一种条件允许改进器发生变化，另一种条件则将其固定，如 Darwin Gödel Machine [1] 和 Hyperagents [11] 所做的那样。 它检验的是允许改进器发生变化是否在整个运行过程中带来帮助，但由于两个分支访问的是不同的状态，这本身并不能证明后来的改进器在同一状态下优于较早的改进器。

sents.en: An evolving-versus-frozen comparison evaluates the whole loop under two conditions, allowing the improver to change in one and holding it fixed in the other, as in the Darwin Gödel Machine [ 1 ] and Hyperagents [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 演化对比冻结的评估方式在两种条件下评估整个循环：一种条件允许改进器发生变化，另一种条件则将其固定，如 Darwin Gödel Machine [1] 和 Hyperagents [11] 所做的那样。

sents.en: It tests whether letting the improver change helps over a run, but because the two arms visit different states, it does not by itself show that a later improver beats an earlier one at a common state.
sents.zh: 它检验的是允许改进器发生变化是否在整个运行过程中带来帮助，但由于两个分支访问的是不同的状态，这本身并不能证明后来的改进器在同一状态下优于较早的改进器。

paragraphs.en: A third group of comparisons freezes another adaptive component, such as the evaluator in the Red Queen Gödel Machine [ 14 ] or a curriculum rule recomputed from the current model. These ablations test the value of adaptation rather than the improvement of the improver.
paragraphs.zh: 第三组比较会冻结另一个自适应组件，例如 Red Queen Gödel Machine [ 14 ] 中的评估器，或从当前模型重新计算的课程规则。 这些消融实验检验的是自适应的价值，而非「改进者的改进」。

sents.en: A third group of comparisons freezes another adaptive component, such as the evaluator in the Red Queen Gödel Machine [ 14 ] or a curriculum rule recomputed from the current model.
sents.zh: 第三组比较会冻结另一个自适应组件，例如 Red Queen Gödel Machine [ 14 ] 中的评估器，或从当前模型重新计算的课程规则。

sents.en: These ablations test the value of adaptation rather than the improvement of the improver.
sents.zh: 这些消融实验检验的是自适应的价值，而非「改进者的改进」。

paragraphs.en: Interpreting these tests also requires matching the stated scope to the evaluated setting. HELIX names model–harness co-evolution in its title and states in its limitations that it does not train an updated model [ 111 ] , so the title describes a capability the study does not test. The MetaRSI abstract argues that RSI must eventually operate in scientific domains where correctness is settled by argument, replication or measurement, while its experiments use executable coding and closed-form science [ 8 ] . This statement describes the motivation for the work rather than a claim about the present system. S1 records both kinds of gap because both appear in the framing of a study. Scoping can also be explicit: Frontis-MA1 describes itself as a step toward meta-evolution that does not yet realize RSI [ 95 ] , so its evidence for a better product matches its claim.
paragraphs.zh: 解读这些测试还需要将所声明的范围与所评估的设置相匹配。 HELIX 在标题中点明了模型与测试框架的协同演化，并在局限性部分说明它并未训练出更新的模型 [ 111 ] ，因此标题描述了一项该研究并未检验的能力。 MetaRSI 的摘要主张递归自我改进（RSI）最终必须在以论证、复现或测量来判定正确性的科学领域中运行，而其实验却使用可执行代码和闭式科学 [ 8 ] 。 这句话描述的是该工作的动机，而非对当前系统的声明。 S1 同时记录这两类差距，因为两者都出现在研究的框架表述中。 范围界定也可以是明确的：Frontis-MA1 将自己描述为迈向元演化的一步，但尚未实现递归自我改进（RSI） [ 95 ] ，因此其关于更好产品的证据与其声明相吻合。

sents.zh: 解读这些测试还需要将所声明的范围与所评估的设置相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Together, these cases show why the development signal, audit, process controls and stated scope need to be reported as one account of the experiment. The discussion translates these evaluation needs into reporting recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，这些案例说明了为什么必须将开发信号、审计、过程控制及所述范围作为实验的统一整体加以报告。 讨论部分将这些评估需求转化为报告建议。

sents.en: Together, these cases show why the development signal, audit, process controls and stated scope need to be reported as one account of the experiment.
sents.zh: 总而言之，这些案例说明了为什么必须将开发信号、审计、过程控制及所述范围作为实验的统一整体加以报告。

sents.en: The discussion translates these evaluation needs into reporting recommendations.
sents.zh: 讨论部分将这些评估需求转化为报告建议。

paragraphs.en: The findings identify two priorities for process evaluation: audited reruns and comparisons that isolate improver gains. Product evaluation is widely reported, although its separation from selection is often partial or unstated. Repeated runs of the full loop are expensive when each run trains models or executes many agent episodes, and 73% of the studies report one run or do not state how many they ran. Deep reinforcement learning shows the same tendency, where computationally demanding benchmarks have led to evaluation on few runs [ 69 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果指出了过程评估的两个优先事项：经审计的重复运行，以及能够分离出改进器增益的对比实验。 产品评估被广泛报道，尽管其与选择的区分往往不完整或未加说明。 当每次运行都需要训练模型或执行大量智能体片段时，完整循环的重复运行成本高昂，73% 的研究仅报告一次运行或未说明运行次数。 深度强化学习也表现出同样的倾向，计算开销大的基准测试导致评估仅在少数几次运行中进行 [ 69 ] 。

sents.en: The findings identify two priorities for process evaluation: audited reruns and comparisons that isolate improver gains.
sents.zh: 研究结果指出了过程评估的两个优先事项：经审计的重复运行，以及能够分离出改进器增益的对比实验。

sents.en: Product evaluation is widely reported, although its separation from selection is often partial or unstated.
sents.zh: 产品评估被广泛报道，尽管其与选择的区分往往不完整或未加说明。

sents.en: Repeated runs of the full loop are expensive when each run trains models or executes many agent episodes, and 73% of the studies report one run or do not state how many they ran.
sents.zh: 当每次运行都需要训练模型或执行大量智能体片段时，完整循环的重复运行成本高昂，73% 的研究仅报告一次运行或未说明运行次数。

sents.en: Deep reinforcement learning shows the same tendency, where computationally demanding benchmarks have led to evaluation on few runs [ 69 ] .
sents.zh: 深度强化学习也表现出同样的倾向，计算开销大的基准测试导致评估仅在少数几次运行中进行 [ 69 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The improver gap concerns experimental design. Most studies claiming a better improver report a related comparison, and these comparisons usually favor the proposed method. Many, however, test the value of adaptation or compare different methods without isolating the difference between an earlier and a later improver at a common state. Proposition 3 implies that more experiments of the same kind would not close this gap. Closing it requires a different design.
paragraphs.zh: 改进器的差距问题涉及实验设计。 大多数声称提出更好改进器的研究都报告了相关比较，而这些比较通常有利于所提出的方法。 然而，许多研究测试的是适应的价值，或比较不同的方法，而没有在共同状态下分离出较早改进器与较晚改进器之间的差异。 命题 3 意味着更多同类实验无法弥合这一差距。 弥合这一差距需要不同的实验设计。

sents.en: The improver gap concerns experimental design.
sents.zh: 改进器的差距问题涉及实验设计。

sents.en: Most studies claiming a better improver report a related comparison, and these comparisons usually favor the proposed method.
sents.zh: 大多数声称提出更好改进器的研究都报告了相关比较，而这些比较通常有利于所提出的方法。

sents.en: Many, however, test the value of adaptation or compare different methods without isolating the difference between an earlier and a later improver at a common state.
sents.zh: 然而，许多研究测试的是适应的价值，或比较不同的方法，而没有在共同状态下分离出较早改进器与较晚改进器之间的差异。

sents.en: Proposition 3 implies that more experiments of the same kind would not close this gap.
sents.zh: 命题 3 意味着更多同类实验无法弥合这一差距。

sents.en: Closing it requires a different design.
sents.zh: 弥合这一差距需要不同的实验设计。

paragraphs.en: These results extend meta-research on machine learning evaluation to claims about a process. Earlier studies measured documentation, significance testing, run counts and leakage for claims about a final model [ 66 , 67 , 71 ] . In RSI research the relevant unit is the claim, because a study can meet every requirement of a product claim and still report nothing that bears on the process it names. The same claim-level coding could be applied to other research whose claims concern how systems are produced, such as automated machine learning.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果将关于机器学习评估的元研究扩展到了对某一过程的声称。 早前的研究针对关于最终模型的声称测量了文档记录、显著性检验、运行次数和数据泄漏 [ 66 , 67 , 71 ] 。 在 RSI 研究中，相关单位是声称，因为一项研究可以满足关于产品的声称的每项要求，却仍然没有报告任何与其所命名的过程相关的内容。 同样的声称层面编码可以应用于其他其声称涉及系统如何被产出的研究，例如自动化机器学习。

paragraphs.en: The findings and cases point to one reporting need: readers should be able to trace an improvement claim to the experiment that evaluates it. We therefore index the standard by claim (Table 9 ). The general requirements apply to every study, while the remaining rows specify the evidence needed for each claim. A study claiming only a better product should therefore follow the general row and the C1 row. The recommendations build on Wu et al. [17] and Wang et al. [18] , and the last column of the table gives the measured rate of each row’s strict indicator as a baseline.

paragraphs.en: The first row asks for what every claim needs. A paper should state which claim in Table 2 it makes, what persists between rounds, and the tasks and domains to which the result applies. This is particularly relevant to the 30% of strong-label studies coded with a gap between stated and tested scope, and to the 55% found in the adjudicated sample. The description of the evaluation should then state whether any reported test was used for selection, checkpoint choice or hyperparameter tuning, and should distinguish a final or prespecified checkpoint from the best checkpoint observed on a benchmark. In this census, 60% of studies report selection-independent evaluation, while 32% use the development signal wholly or partly in a headline result.
paragraphs.zh: 第一行要求说明每项声明所需要的内容。 论文应说明其针对表2中的哪一项声明作出主张、各轮之间保留什么，以及该结果适用的任务和领域。 这与30%的强标签研究（其声明范围与实际测试范围之间存在差距）以及裁定样本中发现的55%尤为相关。 评估描述应说明任何已报告的测试是否用于选择、检查点选择或超参数调优，并应区分最终或预先指定的检查点与在基准上观察到的最佳检查点。 在本次普查中，60%的研究报告了与选择无关的评估，而32%的研究在主要结果中全部或部分使用了开发信号。

paragraphs.en: The grader needs a corresponding description. When a model judge supplies audit scores, authors should state its relationship to the actor and the development judge. They should also report its agreement with a reference, such as executable checks of the same property or expert labels, on outputs produced after optimization. When the system’s own evaluator sits on an audit panel, reporting results with and without it shows how much the score depends on that evaluator, as in Iacob et al. [14] . These details connect the observed score to the shared-error concern of Proposition 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 评分器需要相应的描述。 当模型裁判提供审计分数时，作者应说明其与智能体以及开发裁判的关系。 他们还应报告该裁判与参考标准的一致性，例如对同一属性的可执行检查或专家标注，并在优化后产生的输出上进行报告。 当系统自身的评估器参与审计小组时，报告包含和不包含该评估器的结果可以显示分数对该评估器的依赖程度，如 Iacob et al. [14] 所示。 这些细节将观测到的分数与命题 2 的共享误差问题联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Controls are conditional because they answer specific questions. A protected final test can establish a product gain without a null-loop experiment. A null control, such as shuffled feedback or inert proposals, estimates the gain that selection alone produces, which matters when many candidates are scored. A promotion rule with a stated error guarantee bounds false acceptance under its assumptions [ 57 ] . A budget-matched comparator tests whether the update mechanism beats other uses of the same resources. The census rates are 19% for null controls, 19% for noise-aware promotion and 37% for budget-matched comparators.
paragraphs.zh: 控制条件之所以是有条件的，是因为它们回答特定的问题。 一个受保护的最终测试可以在没有零回路实验的情况下确立产品收益。 零控制（例如打乱反馈或惰性提案）估计仅靠选择就能产生的收益，当许多候选者被评分时，这一点很重要。 带有明确误差保证的晋升规则在其假设下界定了错误接受 [ 57 ]。 预算匹配的对照物检验更新机制是否优于对相同资源的其他用途。 普查比例为：零控制为 19%，噪声感知晋升为 19%，预算匹配对照物为 37%。

paragraphs.en: Resource accounting answers three separate questions. Performance at an equal evaluation or inference budget concerns the product. Improvement yield at an equal search or training budget concerns the loop, and it is what a budget-matched comparator measures. End-to-end cost, including evaluator calls, data, failed candidates and human work, determines whether running the loop is worthwhile. Matching the number of proposals does not by itself match tokens, training compute or wall-clock time, so the matched quantity should be named.
paragraphs.zh: 资源核算回答三个相互独立的问题。 在相同评估或推理预算下的性能，关注的是产品。 在相同搜索或训练预算下的改进产出，关注的是循环，而这正是预算对齐比较器所度量的内容。 端到端成本，包括评估器调用、数据、失败的候选方案和人力投入，决定了运行这个循环是否值得。 匹配提案数量本身并不等于匹配 token 数、训练算力或实际耗时，因此应当明确说明所匹配的量。

paragraphs.en: Process claims need observations of the process itself. For accumulation, a predeclared audit schedule suffices for a finite-horizon claim, provided that the schedule matches the claim. For repeatability, two runs document repetition but do not by themselves establish a reliable gain. Authors should state the quantity they aim to estimate and the precision of the estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 过程类主张需要对过程本身的观察。 对于累积性，只要预先声明的审计计划与主张相匹配，就足以支持有限期的主张。 对于可重复性，两次运行记录了重复，但其本身并不能确立可靠的增益。 作者应说明其旨在估计的量以及该估计的精度。

paragraphs.en: For an improver gain, the comparison should apply both improvers to identical starting artifacts, or pair them over a declared set of starting states, while holding budgets fixed. Equal starting scores are not enough. Authors should also specify whether the contrast concerns one state or an average over the set. An inconclusive comparison, as in Srikanth et al. [12] , is a tested claim with an uncertain result, not an absent test.
paragraphs.zh: 对于改进器增益的比较，应将两个改进器应用于相同的起始工件，或在声明的一组起始状态上进行配对，同时保持预算固定。 相同的起始分数是不够的。 作者还应说明该对比是针对单一状态，还是对该组状态取平均值。 一个非决定性的比较，如 Srikanth 等人 [12] 所示，是一个经过测试但结果不确定的声明，而不是缺少测试。

paragraphs.en: Finally, changes to an evaluator, rubric or test suite should be documented alongside the system updates: what changed, why, who authorized it, and the scores before and after on a fixed reference. Human repairs to the harness belong in this record, as the robotics study of Wang [16] illustrates.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，对评估器、评分规则或测试套件的更改应与系统更新一并记录：改了什么、为什么改、由谁批准，以及在固定参考集上更改前后的分数。 人对测试框架的修复也应记入该记录，正如 Wang [16] 的机器人研究所展示的那样。

paragraphs.en: The census describes reported evaluation practices within a defined literature frame. Its phrase-based search captures arXiv records that use the RSI label and omits work on similar mechanisms that does not use that phrase. The anchor works provide a useful comparison largely outside the frame, but they are a selected set rather than a representative sample. Their similar pattern does not establish prevalence across self-improvement research. Search tokenization and the freeze date also affect the retrieved population. We therefore report the exact queries and chronology in Appendix C . The temporal comparisons detect no statistically significant differences, but their intervals include substantial change, so they do not establish that evaluation practice is stable.
paragraphs.zh: 本普查描述了在既定文献范围内所报告的评估实践。 其基于短语的检索会捕获使用 RSI 标签的 arXiv 记录，并遗漏未使用该短语的关于类似机制的研究。 锚定文献在很大程度上提供了该范围之外的有用对比，但它们是一个经过挑选的集合，而非具有代表性的样本。 它们相似的模式并不能证明这种情况在自我改进研究中普遍存在。 检索的分词方式以及冻结日期也会影响所获取的文献群体。 因此，我们在附录 C 中报告了确切的查询语句和时间顺序。 这些时间性比较未检测到统计上显著的差异，但其区间包含了较大的变化幅度，因此它们并不能证明评估实践是稳定的。

paragraphs.en: The codes describe what papers report, not all experiments their authors may have conducted. Distinguishing strong and weak labels, partial and selection-independent evaluation, or explicit and implicit scope requires judgment. An LLM-based assistant supported the first coding pass and the later recodes, and the adjudication shows that this pass erred far more often than the independent human coding. We replaced the codes of the double-coded studies with the adjudicated ones, adopted the independent codes for the improver comparisons, and revised the decision rules for the rest. Outside these two sets, individual codes have not been checked by a human. The independent improver coding covers studies with an improver claim or a previously coded comparison. A missed comparison in a study with neither would therefore go undetected. The random sample supports checks of aggregate shares, not corrections of individual codes, and it indicates that these codes credit product evaluation, especially selection-independent evaluation, too often and record scope gaps too rarely.
paragraphs.zh: 这些编码描述的是论文所报告的内容，而非其作者可能进行过的所有实验。 区分强标签与弱标签、部分评估与选择无关评估、显式范围与隐式范围，都需要主观判断。 一个基于大语言模型的助手协助了首次编码和后续的重新编码，而裁定结果表明，这一轮出错的频率远高于独立的人工编码。 我们用裁定后的编码替换了双重编码研究的编码，对改进器比较采用独立编码，并对其余研究修订了判定规则。 在这两组之外，个别编码尚未经过人工核查。 独立的改进器编码覆盖了包含改进器声明或先前已编码比较的研究。 因此，在一项两者皆无的研究中，被遗漏的比较将无法被发现。 随机样本支持对总体比例的核查，而非对个别编码的修正；它表明这些编码过于频繁地把功劳归于产品评估，尤其是选择无关评估，而记录范围缺失的情况则过少。

sents.en: The codes describe what papers report, not all experiments their authors may have conducted.
sents.zh: 这些编码描述的是论文所报告的内容，而非其作者可能进行过的所有实验。

sents.en: Distinguishing strong and weak labels, partial and selection-independent evaluation, or explicit and implicit scope requires judgment.
sents.zh: 区分强标签与弱标签、部分评估与选择无关评估、显式范围与隐式范围，都需要主观判断。

sents.en: An LLM-based assistant supported the first coding pass and the later recodes, and the adjudication shows that this pass erred far more often than the independent human coding.
sents.zh: 一个基于大语言模型的助手协助了首次编码和后续的重新编码，而裁定结果表明，这一轮出错的频率远高于独立的人工编码。

sents.en: We replaced the codes of the double-coded studies with the adjudicated ones, adopted the independent codes for the improver comparisons, and revised the decision rules for the rest.
sents.zh: 我们用裁定后的编码替换了双重编码研究的编码，对改进器比较采用独立编码，并对其余研究修订了判定规则。

sents.en: Outside these two sets, individual codes have not been checked by a human.
sents.zh: 在这两组之外，个别编码尚未经过人工核查。

sents.en: The independent improver coding covers studies with an improver claim or a previously coded comparison.
sents.zh: 独立的改进器编码覆盖了包含改进器声明或先前已编码比较的研究。

sents.en: A missed comparison in a study with neither would therefore go undetected.
sents.zh: 因此，在一项两者皆无的研究中，被遗漏的比较将无法被发现。

sents.en: The random sample supports checks of aggregate shares, not corrections of individual codes, and it indicates that these codes credit product evaluation, especially selection-independent evaluation, too often and record scope gaps too rarely.
sents.zh: 随机样本支持对总体比例的核查，而非对个别编码的修正；它表明这些编码过于频繁地把功劳归于产品评估，尤其是选择无关评估，而记录范围缺失的情况则过少。

paragraphs.en: A single third reader settled the disagreements, so the adjudicated codes reflect one interpretation of the codebook. Adjudication produces a consensus rather than a reliability estimate. The improver comparisons received a separate blind coding pass, followed by application of the stricter same-start rule. The other final rules have not been independently applied to a fresh sample of the remaining studies. The reasons for partial separation and the types of divergence also lack a second coding.
paragraphs.zh: 由单一的第三位读者来解决分歧，因此裁定后的编码反映的是对编码手册的一种解读。 裁定产生的是共识，而非信度估计。 对改进器的比较进行了单独的盲法编码，随后应用了更严格的同起始规则。 其余的最终规则尚未在剩余研究的全新样本上独立应用。 部分分离的原因以及分歧的类型也缺乏第二次编码。

sents.en: A single third reader settled the disagreements, so the adjudicated codes reflect one interpretation of the codebook.
sents.zh: 由单一的第三位读者来解决分歧，因此裁定后的编码反映的是对编码手册的一种解读。

sents.en: Adjudication produces a consensus rather than a reliability estimate.
sents.zh: 裁定产生的是共识，而非信度估计。

sents.en: The improver comparisons received a separate blind coding pass, followed by application of the stricter same-start rule.
sents.zh: 对改进器的比较进行了单独的盲法编码，随后应用了更严格的同起始规则。

sents.en: The other final rules have not been independently applied to a fresh sample of the remaining studies.
sents.zh: 其余的最终规则尚未在剩余研究的全新样本上独立应用。

sents.en: The reasons for partial separation and the types of divergence also lack a second coding.
sents.zh: 部分分离的原因以及分歧的类型也缺乏第二次编码。

paragraphs.en: Eligibility screening was not independently checked, so false exclusions of benchmark and evaluation papers that run an improving system of their own remain possible. The comparison with protocol descriptions from Wu et al. [17] checks selected interpretations rather than providing an additional reliability estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 合格性筛查未经独立核对，因此仍可能错误排除那些自行运行改进系统的基准论文和评估论文。 与 Wu 等人的协议描述进行的比较 [17] 检查的是选定的解释，而非提供额外的可靠性估计。

sents.zh: 合格性筛查未经独立核对，因此仍可能错误排除那些自行运行改进系统的基准论文和评估论文。

sents.en: The comparison with protocol descriptions from Wu et al.
sents.zh: 与 Wu 等人的协议描述进行的比较

sents.en: [17] checks selected interpretations rather than providing an additional reliability estimate.
sents.zh: [17] 检查的是选定的解释，而非提供额外的可靠性估计。

paragraphs.en: Some distinctions exceed what the current codes measure. Grader type does not establish independence of errors, and the codebook does not record reference validation for every audit grader. The unit of coding is the study, so a study can combine a held-out product test on one benchmark with an improver comparison on another. The E4 bundle therefore does not guarantee that a single experiment meets the requirements of C4. The scope item compares the framing in the title, abstract and introduction with the tested setting, so it records gaps in framing, including statements of motivation, rather than a rate of overclaiming.
paragraphs.zh: 有些区别超出了当前编码所能衡量的范围。 评分器类型并不能确立误差的独立性，而且编码手册并未记录每个审计评分器的参考答案验证情况。 编码的单位是研究，因此一项研究可以将一个基准上的留出产品测试与另一个基准上的改进器比较结合起来。 因此，E4 包并不保证单个实验满足 C4 的要求。 范围项将标题、摘要和引言中的表述与实际测试的设置进行比较，因此它记录的是表述上的差距（包括动机陈述），而不是夸大结论的发生率。

sents.en: Some distinctions exceed what the current codes measure.
sents.zh: 有些区别超出了当前编码所能衡量的范围。

sents.zh: 因此，E4 包并不保证单个实验满足 C4 的要求。

paragraphs.en: The per-round item includes scheduled checkpoints and held-out metrics of an updated component, so it is broader than an audit at every round. Evidence tiers summarize reported designs rather than successful demonstrations, and the divergence cases are documented examples of several kinds, not a failure rate. Several claim-conditioned populations are small, including the 26 improver claimants, so their shares carry wide intervals. These boundaries are important when moving from descriptive counts to judgments about individual methods.
paragraphs.zh: 每轮的项目包括更新组件的预定检查点和保留指标，因此它比每一轮的审计范围更广。 证据层级总结的是已报告的设计而非成功的演示，且分歧案例是记录在案的多类示例，并非失败率。 若干按声明划分的群体规模很小，包括 26 个改进声明者，因此它们的份额带有较宽的区间。 在从描述性计数转向对单个方法的判断时，这些边界非常重要。

sents.en: The per-round item includes scheduled checkpoints and held-out metrics of an updated component, so it is broader than an audit at every round.
sents.zh: 每轮的项目包括更新组件的预定检查点和保留指标，因此它比每一轮的审计范围更广。

sents.en: Evidence tiers summarize reported designs rather than successful demonstrations, and the divergence cases are documented examples of several kinds, not a failure rate.
sents.zh: 证据层级总结的是已报告的设计而非成功的演示，且分歧案例是记录在案的多类示例，并非失败率。

sents.en: Several claim-conditioned populations are small, including the 26 improver claimants, so their shares carry wide intervals.
sents.zh: 若干按声明划分的群体规模很小，包括 26 个改进声明者，因此它们的份额带有较宽的区间。

sents.en: These boundaries are important when moving from descriptive counts to judgments about individual methods.
sents.zh: 在从描述性计数转向对单个方法的判断时，这些边界非常重要。

paragraphs.en: The propositions isolate evaluation problems under stylized assumptions. The null model assumes a common affine score scale, independent and identically distributed development errors, and conditionally unbiased audit errors. The other propositions use a linear shared-bias model and a deterministic relationship between a separable solver state and its improver, respectively. They explain limits of inference under those assumptions rather than estimating the size of an effect in a particular study. The paper therefore does not establish that current loops fail to improve systems. Its contribution is to distinguish the evidence reported for products from that reported for processes and to identify the additional tests needed for stronger claims.
paragraphs.zh: 这些命题在风格化的假设下隔离出评估问题。 零假设模型假定一个共同的仿射分数尺度、独立同分布的开发误差，以及条件无偏的审计误差。 其他命题分别使用线性共享偏差模型，以及可分离求解器状态与其改进者之间的确定性关系。 它们解释的是在这些假设下推断的局限，而非估计某项特定研究中效应的大小。 因此，本文并未证明当前的循环无法改进系统。 它的贡献在于区分针对产品的证据与针对过程的证据，并指出要得出更强结论所需的额外检验。

sents.zh: 这些命题在风格化的假设下隔离出评估问题。

sents.zh: 因此，本文并未证明当前的循环无法改进系统。

sents.zh: 它的贡献在于区分针对产品的证据与针对过程的证据，并指出要得出更强结论所需的额外检验。

paragraphs.en: These limitations point to work that the dataset and codebook make possible. Applying the final rules to a fresh random sample, with a second coding of the reasons for partial separation and the types of divergence, would give reliability estimates for the final rules, and independent screening would test the eligibility decisions. Recording reference validation for each audit grader would let the census assess grader independence rather than grader type alone. Extending the search to work on similar mechanisms that does not use the RSI label, and repeating the census as the literature grows, would show whether the gaps in audited reruns and same-start comparisons persist.
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性指向了该数据集和代码簿所能支持的后续工作。 将最终规则应用于新的随机样本，并对部分分离的原因和分歧的类型进行第二次编码，将能为最终规则提供信度估计，而独立筛选则可检验资格判定。 记录每个审计评分者的参考文献验证情况，可以让普查评估评分者的独立性，而不仅仅是评分者类型。 将检索范围扩展到研究类似机制但不使用 RSI 标签的文献，并随着文献的增长重复该普查，将能揭示已审计重跑与同起点比较中的缺口是否持续存在。

sents.zh: 这些局限性指向了该数据集和代码簿所能支持的后续工作。

paragraphs.en: This study examined how closely RSI evaluations match the claims made about improvement processes. Product evaluation is widely reported, although fewer studies fully separate it from selection. Most studies claiming accumulating gains audit across rounds, but evaluation of repeatability is less common. Audited reruns, which test whether a loop’s gains repeat, appear in only 22% of the studies. Similarly, only 4 of the 26 studies claiming a better improver compare earlier and later improvers from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. Most report related comparisons, but these address different questions. The human-coded sample, the independent improver coding, and the comparison set support this central distinction. The case analysis illustrates why it matters: development gains, audited product gains, and improved procedures can diverge.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究考察了RSI评估与改进过程相关声明之间的匹配程度。 产品评估被广泛报告，但很少有研究将其与选择完全区分开来。 大多数声称收益不断累积的研究都会跨轮次进行审计，但对可重复性的评估则较为少见。 经过审计的重跑，即检验循环的收益是否能重复出现，仅出现在22%的研究中。 同样，在26项声称存在更优改进者的研究中，仅有4项在相同起始工件和匹配预算下比较了早期与后期的改进者。 大多数研究报告了相关的比较，但这些比较回答的是不同的问题。 人工编码的样本、独立的改进者编码以及比较集都支持这一核心区分。 案例分析说明了为什么这一点很重要：开发收益、经过审计的产品收益以及改进后的流程可能彼此背离。

sents.zh: 人工编码的样本、独立的改进者编码以及比较集都支持这一核心区分。

sents.en: The case analysis illustrates why it matters: development gains, audited product gains, and improved procedures can diverge.
sents.zh: 案例分析说明了为什么这一点很重要：开发收益、经过审计的产品收益以及改进后的流程可能彼此背离。

paragraphs.en: The reporting standard derived from these findings connects claims to development signals, audit boundaries, process controls and resource accounting, so that an experiment states what it establishes and which stronger claims require more evidence. Releasing the dataset and codebook will allow the measurements to be repeated as the literature grows and will support a clearer empirical assessment of progress toward better improvers.
paragraphs.zh: 由这些发现推导出的报告标准将声明与开发信号、审计边界、过程控制和资源核算相连接，从而使实验说明其确立了什么，以及哪些更强的声明需要更多证据。 发布数据集和代码手册将使这些测量能够随着文献的增长而被重复进行，并支持对朝向更好的改进器的进展做出更清晰的实证评估。

sents.en: The reporting standard derived from these findings connects claims to development signals, audit boundaries, process controls and resource accounting, so that an experiment states what it establishes and which stronger claims require more evidence.
sents.zh: 由这些发现推导出的报告标准将声明与开发信号、审计边界、过程控制和资源核算相连接，从而使实验说明其确立了什么，以及哪些更强的声明需要更多证据。

paragraphs.en: The initial codebook was frozen after the pilot. The v1.1 decision rules below clarify the items revised after the blind coding, the v1.2 rules add three items and the logical constraints between items, and v1.3 records the independent coding of the improver comparisons. paragraphs.zh: 单位是一项符合条件的研究，其编码取自冻结日期时可获得的最新版本。 每个非平凡代码都带有指向章节、表格、图或附录的定位符。 数值 NR 表示未报告，且绝不会被解读为控制失败。

sents.en: The unit is one eligible study, coded from the latest version available on the freeze date.
sents.zh: 单位是一项符合条件的研究，其编码取自冻结日期时可获得的最新版本。

sents.en: Every non-trivial code carries a locator to a section, table, figure or appendix.
sents.zh: 每个非平凡代码都带有指向章节、表格、图或附录的定位符。

sents.en: The value NR means not reported and is never read as a failed control.
sents.zh: 数值 NR 表示未报告，且绝不会被解读为控制失败。

paragraphs.en: The pilot established a full-text reading procedure: inspect the experimental setup for data splits and hidden tests, search appendices for checkpoint and hyperparameter selection, and examine frozen-improver, fixed-executor, and swap comparisons. It also established that scope must be coded from the authors’ claims, and v1.1 specifies which sections govern that judgment. Table 10 lists the study descriptors and claims, and Table 11 lists the audit and process items.
paragraphs.zh: 试点确立了一套全文阅读流程：检查实验设置以了解数据划分和隐藏测试，在附录中查找检查点与超参数选择，并审视冻结改进器、固定执行器与交换对比。 试点还确立了范围必须依据作者的论断进行编码，v1.1 规定了哪些章节可作为该判断的依据。 表 10 列出研究描述符与论断，表 11 列出审计与流程条目。

sents.en: The pilot established a full-text reading procedure: inspect the experimental setup for data splits and hidden tests, search appendices for checkpoint and hyperparameter selection, and examine frozen-improver, fixed-executor, and swap comparisons.
sents.zh: 试点确立了一套全文阅读流程：检查实验设置以了解数据划分和隐藏测试，在附录中查找检查点与超参数选择，并审视冻结改进器、固定执行器与交换对比。

sents.en: It also established that scope must be coded from the authors’ claims, and v1.1 specifies which sections govern that judgment.
sents.zh: 试点还确立了范围必须依据作者的论断进行编码，v1.1 规定了哪些章节可作为该判断的依据。

sents.en: Table 10 lists the study descriptors and claims, and Table 11 lists the audit and process items.
sents.zh: 表 10 列出研究描述符与论断，表 11 列出审计与流程条目。

paragraphs.en: The blind coding showed systematic differences in how several items were interpreted. We clarified the following rules before recoding the affected items in every study. A report that specifies a loop but runs no experiment on it is excluded as a position paper.
paragraphs.zh: 盲测编码显示，若干条目的解读方式存在系统性差异。 在对每项研究中受影响的条目重新编码之前，我们明确了以下规则。 报告若指明了一个循环但未针对其运行任何实验，则作为立场论文予以排除。

sents.en: The blind coding showed systematic differences in how several items were interpreted.
sents.zh: 盲测编码显示，若干条目的解读方式存在系统性差异。

sents.en: We clarified the following rules before recoding the affected items in every study.
sents.zh: 在对每项研究中受影响的条目重新编码之前，我们明确了以下规则。

sents.en: A report that specifies a loop but runs no experiment on it is excluded as a position paper.
sents.zh: 报告若指明了一个循环但未针对其运行任何实验，则作为立场论文予以排除。

paragraphs.en: For evaluation separation, A1 is P whenever any headline number includes development, search or selection tasks. A2 is Y only if the held-out tasks were also unused for checkpoint, round, archive-member, hyperparameter and default choices and no “best observed on test” value enters the headline. Target-conditioned loops that attempt the evaluation tasks themselves have A2 = N.
paragraphs.zh: 就评估分离而言，只要任一头条数字包含开发、搜索或选择任务，A1 即为 P。 仅当保留任务也未用于检查点、轮次、存档成员、超参数和默认选择，且没有「在测试上观察到的最佳」数值进入头条时，A2 才为 Y。 尝试自行完成评估任务的目标条件循环的 A2 为 N。

sents.en: For evaluation separation, A1 is P whenever any headline number includes development, search or selection tasks.
sents.zh: 就评估分离而言，只要任一头条数字包含开发、搜索或选择任务，A1 即为 P。

sents.en: A2 is Y only if the held-out tasks were also unused for checkpoint, round, archive-member, hyperparameter and default choices and no “best observed on test” value enters the headline.
sents.zh: 仅当保留任务也未用于检查点、轮次、存档成员、超参数和默认选择，且没有「在测试上观察到的最佳」数值进入头条时，A2 才为 Y。

sents.en: Target-conditioned loops that attempt the evaluation tasks themselves have A2 = N.
sents.zh: 尝试自行完成评估任务的目标条件循环的 A2 为 N。

paragraphs.en: For controls, A5 is Y for any control that keeps the loop’s budget but removes or randomizes the information that drives selection, including random selection, fixed-proportion selection without feedback, retries without a retained update, and independent sampling from the same start. A6 is Y when candidates are accepted after repeated multi-seed evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于对照组，若某对照保留了循环的预算但移除或随机化了驱动选择的信息，包括随机选择、无反馈的固定比例选择、不保留更新的重试，以及从同一起点进行的独立采样，则 A5 为 Y。 当候选在经过多次多随机种子评估后被接受时，A6 为 Y。

sents.en: For controls, A5 is Y for any control that keeps the loop’s budget but removes or randomizes the information that drives selection, including random selection, fixed-proportion selection without feedback, retries without a retained update, and independent sampling from the same start.
sents.zh: 对于对照组，若某对照保留了循环的预算但移除或随机化了驱动选择的信息，包括随机选择、无反馈的固定比例选择、不保留更新的重试，以及从同一起点进行的独立采样，则 A5 为 Y。

sents.en: A6 is Y when candidates are accepted after repeated multi-seed evaluation.
sents.zh: 当候选在经过多次多随机种子评估后被接受时，A6 为 Y。

paragraphs.en: For process evaluation, P1 counts held-out scores at every retained round or checkpoint, including held-out component metrics and periodic checkpoints. P4 is Y for frozen-improver, frozen-evaluator, frozen-curriculum or frozen-operator controls, or earlier-versus-later improvers from a common start, at matched or stated-equal budget, and P for swaps between different improvers or unmatched budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 对于过程评估，P1 统计每个保留轮次或检查点的留出分数，包括留出的组件指标和周期性检查点。 当比较对象为冻结改进器、冻结评估器、冻结课程或冻结操作员的对照，以及来自相同起点的早期与晚期改进器，且在匹配预算或声明相等预算下时，P4 为 Y；对于不同改进器之间或预算不匹配的交换，则为 P。

sents.en: For process evaluation, P1 counts held-out scores at every retained round or checkpoint, including held-out component metrics and periodic checkpoints.
sents.zh: 对于过程评估，P1 统计每个保留轮次或检查点的留出分数，包括留出的组件指标和周期性检查点。

sents.en: P4 is Y for frozen-improver, frozen-evaluator, frozen-curriculum or frozen-operator controls, or earlier-versus-later improvers from a common start, at matched or stated-equal budget, and P for swaps between different improvers or unmatched budgets.
sents.zh: 当比较对象为冻结改进器、冻结评估器、冻结课程或冻结操作员的对照，以及来自相同起点的早期与晚期改进器，且在匹配预算或声明相等预算下时，P4 为 Y；对于不同改进器之间或预算不匹配的交换，则为 P。

paragraphs.en: Scope (S1) is judged on the title, abstract and introduction, and a later concession in a limitations section does not remove a scope gap there. B for the reported checkpoint also covers the best archive member chosen on the reported tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 范围（S1）依据标题、摘要和引言来判断，之后在局限性章节中的让步并不能消除那里的范围缺口。 B（针对所报告的检查点）也涵盖在所报告任务上选出的最佳存档成员。

sents.en: Scope (S1) is judged on the title, abstract and introduction, and a later concession in a limitations section does not remove a scope gap there.
sents.zh: 范围（S1）依据标题、摘要和引言来判断，之后在局限性章节中的让步并不能消除那里的范围缺口。

sents.en: B for the reported checkpoint also covers the best archive member chosen on the reported tasks.
sents.zh: B（针对所报告的检查点）也涵盖在所报告任务上选出的最佳存档成员。

paragraphs.en: A study is eligible if it runs its loop and describes the outcome, quantitatively or qualitatively. A report that specifies a loop and an evaluation protocol but never runs the loop is excluded. Eligibility never depends on the direction of the result.
paragraphs.zh: 如果一项研究运行了其循环并定量或定性地描述了结果，即符合纳入条件。 只规定循环和评估方案但从未运行循环的报告将被排除。 纳入条件绝不取决于结果的方向。

sents.en: A study is eligible if it runs its loop and describes the outcome, quantitatively or qualitatively.
sents.zh: 如果一项研究运行了其循环并定量或定性地描述了结果，即符合纳入条件。

sents.en: A report that specifies a loop and an evaluation protocol but never runs the loop is excluded.
sents.zh: 只规定循环和评估方案但从未运行循环的报告将被排除。

sents.en: Eligibility never depends on the direction of the result.
sents.zh: 纳入条件绝不取决于结果的方向。

paragraphs.en: Four logical rules link the items, with an audit defined as A2 = Y or P. Without an audit, A3 = NA (R1) and P1 = N, because per-round scores are then development scores (R2). Reporting paired development and audit scores (P2 = Y) requires a per-round audit (P1 = Y; R3). Without an audit, P5 = NA because divergence cannot be assessed (R4).
paragraphs.zh: 四条逻辑规则将这些条目关联起来，其中审计定义为 A2 = Y 或 P。 若无审计，则 A3 = NA（R1）且 P1 = N，因为此时每轮分数即为开发分数（R2）。 报告成对的开发和审计分数（P2 = Y）需要进行每轮审计（P1 = Y；R3）。 若无审计，则 P5 = NA，因为无法评估分歧（R4）。

sents.en: Four logical rules link the items, with an audit defined as A2 = Y or P.
sents.zh: 四条逻辑规则将这些条目关联起来，其中审计定义为 A2 = Y 或 P。

sents.en: Without an audit, A3 = NA (R1) and P1 = N, because per-round scores are then development scores (R2).
sents.zh: 若无审计，则 A3 = NA（R1）且 P1 = N，因为此时每轮分数即为开发分数（R2）。

sents.en: Reporting paired development and audit scores (P2 = Y) requires a per-round audit (P1 = Y; R3).
sents.zh: 报告成对的开发和审计分数（P2 = Y）需要进行每轮审计（P1 = Y；R3）。

sents.en: Without an audit, P5 = NA because divergence cannot be assessed (R4).
sents.zh: 若无审计，则 P5 = NA，因为无法评估分歧（R4）。

paragraphs.en: Three items were added. A2r records why an evaluation is only partly separated: R, the evaluation tasks are also used for some selection; H, only part of the headline is held out; U, the paper does not state the separation.
paragraphs.zh: 新增了三个条目。 A2r 记录了评估为何只是部分分离的原因：R，评估任务同时也用于部分选择；H，标题中只有部分被保留出来；U，论文未说明该分离情况。

sents.en: Three items were added.
sents.zh: 新增了三个条目。

sents.en: A2r records why an evaluation is only partly separated: R, the evaluation tasks are also used for some selection; H, only part of the headline is held out; U, the paper does not state the separation.
sents.zh: A2r 记录了评估为何只是部分分离的原因：R，评估任务同时也用于部分选择；H，标题中只有部分被保留出来；U，论文未说明该分离情况。

paragraphs.en: P4d records the design of an improver-related comparison: S, an earlier and a later improver run from identical starting artifacts, or from a declared set of starting states with paired assignment; T, an evolving and a frozen improver each run over the loop; C, another comparison, such as freezing an adaptive evaluator, world model or curriculum rule, or swapping between different models.
paragraphs.zh: P4d 记录一项与改进者相关的对比设计：S，即从相同的起始工件，或从一组已声明的、成对分配的起始状态出发，运行一个较早和一个较晚的改进者；T，即在循环上分别运行一个演化的改进者和一个冻结的改进者；C，即另一类对比，例如冻结自适应评估器、世界模型或课程规则，或在不同模型之间切换。

paragraphs.en: Each divergence case is classified as paired, partial, regression or other, as defined in Table 15 . Evidence tiers are computed from the design items alone, so a study with a negative result keeps the tier of its designs.
paragraphs.zh: 每个分歧案例都按表 15 中的定义分类为成对、部分、回归或其他。 证据层级仅根据研究设计项计算，因此结果为阴性的研究仍保留其设计的层级。

sents.en: Each divergence case is classified as paired, partial, regression or other, as defined in Table 15 .
sents.zh: 每个分歧案例都按表 15 中的定义分类为成对、部分、回归或其他。

sents.en: Evidence tiers are computed from the design items alone, so a study with a negative result keeps the tier of its designs.
sents.zh: 证据层级仅根据研究设计项计算，因此结果为阴性的研究仍保留其设计的层级。

paragraphs.en: For every study and anchor work that claims a better improver or has a coded improver-related comparison, P4 and P4d are the codes of an independent blind coder. This coder also recorded the improver, the result of the comparison (P4r: better, mixed, no clear difference or worse for the paper’s own process) and a locator.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每项声称拥有更好改进器或包含已编码的改进器相关比较的研究及锚定著作，P4 和 P4d 由一位独立盲评编码员进行编码。 该编码员还记录了改进器、比较结果（P4r：更好、混合、无明显差异或更差，针对论文自身的过程）以及一个定位符。

sents.en: For every study and anchor work that claims a better improver or has a coded improver-related comparison, P4 and P4d are the codes of an independent blind coder.
sents.zh: 对于每项声称拥有更好改进器或包含已编码的改进器相关比较的研究及锚定著作，P4 和 P4d 由一位独立盲评编码员进行编码。

sents.en: This coder also recorded the improver, the result of the comparison (P4r: better, mixed, no clear difference or worse for the paper’s own process) and a locator.
sents.zh: 该编码员还记录了改进器、比较结果（P4r：更好、混合、无明显差异或更差，针对论文自身的过程）以及一个定位符。

paragraphs.en: The strict same-start rule is then applied: equal starting scores do not make starting states equal, and an arm that carries solver artifacts, such as program components or a task agent, into the comparison is not a same-start arm. When a study reports several designs, the first that applies in the order S, T, C is recorded. A comparison with a different improver counts as matched (P4 = Y) when the paper states equal budgets and no other uncontrolled differences. This rule replaces the v1.1 rule that coded every such swap as partial.
paragraphs.zh: 然后适用严格的同起点规则：相同的起始分数并不意味着起始状态相同，而将求解器产物（如程序组件或任务智能体）带入比较的分支不是同起点分支。 当一项研究报告多个设计时，按 S、T、C 的顺序记录第一个适用的设计。 当论文声明预算相等且不存在其他未受控差异时，使用不同改进器的比较也算作匹配（P4 = Y）。 此规则取代了 v1.1 中将所有此类替换编码为部分匹配的规则。

sents.en: The strict same-start rule is then applied: equal starting scores do not make starting states equal, and an arm that carries solver artifacts, such as program components or a task agent, into the comparison is not a same-start arm.
sents.zh: 然后适用严格的同起点规则：相同的起始分数并不意味着起始状态相同，而将求解器产物（如程序组件或任务智能体）带入比较的分支不是同起点分支。

sents.en: When a study reports several designs, the first that applies in the order S, T, C is recorded.
sents.zh: 当一项研究报告多个设计时，按 S、T、C 的顺序记录第一个适用的设计。

sents.en: A comparison with a different improver counts as matched (P4 = Y) when the paper states equal budgets and no other uncontrolled differences.
sents.zh: 当论文声明预算相等且不存在其他未受控差异时，使用不同改进器的比较也算作匹配（P4 = Y）。

sents.en: This rule replaces the v1.1 rule that coded every such swap as partial.
sents.zh: 此规则取代了 v1.1 中将所有此类替换编码为部分匹配的规则。

paragraphs.en: We queried the arXiv API on 17 October 2026 with each phrase in the title field and in the abstract field, restricted to submissions up to that date, and took the union of the results. The arXiv search normalizes word forms, so the inflected variants return the same records, but we keep them in the log for transparency. Table 12 lists the queries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们于2026年10月17日查询了 arXiv API，将每个短语分别在标题字段和摘要字段中进行检索，限定提交日期不超过该日期，并取各结果的并集。 arXiv 搜索会对词形进行归一化，因此词形变化的变体返回相同的记录，但为了透明起见，我们将它们保留在日志中。 表12列出了这些查询。

sents.en: We queried the arXiv API on 17 October 2026 with each phrase in the title field and in the abstract field, restricted to submissions up to that date, and took the union of the results.
sents.zh: 我们于2026年10月17日查询了 arXiv API，将每个短语分别在标题字段和摘要字段中进行检索，限定提交日期不超过该日期，并取各结果的并集。

sents.en: The arXiv search normalizes word forms, so the inflected variants return the same records, but we keep them in the log for transparency.
sents.zh: arXiv 搜索会对词形进行归一化，因此词形变化的变体返回相同的记录，但为了透明起见，我们将它们保留在日志中。

sents.en: Table 12 lists the queries.
sents.zh: 表12列出了这些查询。

paragraphs.en: Of the 173 records, 153 were posted in 2026 and 20 earlier. Posting accelerated sharply during 2026: 16 records appeared in the first half of the year, followed by 13 in July, 18 in August, 51 in September and 55 in the first seventeen days of October. These counts include surveys, position papers and other records that the eligibility rules exclude.
paragraphs.zh: 在173条记录中，153条发布于2026年，20条发布于更早时间。 2026年发布速度显著加快：上半年出现16条记录，随后7月13条，8月18条，9月51条，10月前17天55条。 这些统计数字包含资格规则所排除的调查报告、立场文件及其他记录。

sents.en: Of the 173 records, 153 were posted in 2026 and 20 earlier.
sents.zh: 在173条记录中，153条发布于2026年，20条发布于更早时间。

sents.en: Posting accelerated sharply during 2026: 16 records appeared in the first half of the year, followed by 13 in July, 18 in August, 51 in September and 55 in the first seventeen days of October.
sents.zh: 2026年发布速度显著加快：上半年出现16条记录，随后7月13条，8月18条，9月51条，10月前17天55条。

sents.en: These counts include surveys, position papers and other records that the eligibility rules exclude.
sents.zh: 这些统计数字包含资格规则所排除的调查报告、立场文件及其他记录。

paragraphs.en: This appendix lists the main codes for every eligible study in the frame (Table 13 ). These are adjudicated codes for the double-coded sample, independent codes for the improver comparisons, and v1.1 codes otherwise, with the v1.2 rules and the strict same-start rule applied throughout. The remaining tables support three parts of the analysis. Tables 14 and 15 report evaluation items by domain and the documented divergence cases. Tables 16 and 17 report agreement for the double-coded sample and the independent improver coding. Tables 18 , 19 , and 20 present the anchor comparison, the individual anchor codes, and their correspondence with the protocol descriptions of Wu et al. [17] . The full codes, with locators and notes for every item, will be released with the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录列出了框架内每项符合条件研究的主要编码（表 13）。 这些编码对于双重编码样本是裁定后的编码，对于改进者比较是独立编码，其余情况为 v1.1 编码，并全程应用 v1.2 规则和严格的同起始规则。 其余各表支持分析的三个部分。 表 14 和表 15 报告按领域划分的评估条目以及已记录的分歧案例。 表 16 和表 17 报告双重编码样本和改进者独立编码的一致性。 表 18、表 19 和表 20 呈现锚点比较、各条目的锚点编码，以及它们与 Wu 等人 [17] 方案描述的对应关系。 完整的编码（含每个条目的定位信息和注释）将随论文一同发布。

sents.en: This appendix lists the main codes for every eligible study in the frame (Table 13 ).
sents.zh: 本附录列出了框架内每项符合条件研究的主要编码（表 13）。

sents.en: These are adjudicated codes for the double-coded sample, independent codes for the improver comparisons, and v1.1 codes otherwise, with the v1.2 rules and the strict same-start rule applied throughout.
sents.zh: 这些编码对于双重编码样本是裁定后的编码，对于改进者比较是独立编码，其余情况为 v1.1 编码，并全程应用 v1.2 规则和严格的同起始规则。

sents.zh: 其余各表支持分析的三个部分。

sents.en: Tables 14 and 15 report evaluation items by domain and the documented divergence cases.
sents.zh: 表 14 和表 15 报告按领域划分的评估条目以及已记录的分歧案例。

sents.en: Tables 16 and 17 report agreement for the double-coded sample and the independent improver coding.
sents.zh: 表 16 和表 17 报告双重编码样本和改进者独立编码的一致性。

sents.en: Tables 18 , 19 , and 20 present the anchor comparison, the individual anchor codes, and their correspondence with the protocol descriptions of Wu et al. [17] .
sents.zh: 表 18、表 19 和表 20 呈现锚点比较、各条目的锚点编码，以及它们与 Wu 等人 [17] 方案描述的对应关系。

sents.en: The full codes, with locators and notes for every item, will be released with the paper.
sents.zh: 完整的编码（含每个条目的定位信息和注释）将随论文一同发布。
